chunks.body:
No screen of its own: it shows the boot screen until the staff row loads, then redirects to /workspaces when the account holds several workspaces and none is stored on this station, otherwise to the role's home (/till, /kds, /desk/today, /ops, /panel or /tasks).
Roles: any signed-in staff (it only redirects).
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /admin
chunks.body:
A layout with no content of its own: it draws the section tab strip for the Menu and Guest-app families and its index redirects to /admin/menu.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /admin/addons
chunks.body:
The "Add-ons" screen listing item groups and sub-groups of guest choices; "New group" and "New sub-group" open an editor that saves with app.upsert_modifier_group and app.link_item_modifier_group, options save through app.upsert_modifier, and reveals through app.set_modifier_reveals. For a manager an option on sale keeps its price, with "Change the price" (an addon_price price or promo change on /protocols), and a new paid option is saved hidden with its switch off and "Put on sale"; a free option is added and switched as before. A manager's save that would make guests pay more (a paid choice made compulsory by a group's minimum, a link, a reveal, or a free option switched off or moved) is refused and said to be the owner's to make.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /admin/audit — Audit log
chunks.body:
The read-only "Audit log": who did what and why, with period, search, area and actor filters and a "missing reason" toggle; the buttons only refresh, clear filters, expand a row's before and after values, or export CSV.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Audit log"; Management › Observe: "Audit log".

chunks.title: /admin/branches — Branches
chunks.body:
The owner's "Branches" screen (multi-venue slice 4): every Touch location with its status (Preparing, Open, Closed); "Open a new branch" copies the setup of a chosen branch into a new one in Preparing (app.create_branch: courts, rates, hours, tables, menu, recipes, checklists and protocol templates, never promotions, stock or staff); the branch panel shows the checklist before opening (app.branch_readiness: a court with a rate, opening hours, a manager, a registered till, and warnings for the menu, Telegram and opening stock), "Open to guests" (app.open_branch) and "Close branch" (app.close_branch).
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Branches".

chunks.title: /admin/categories
chunks.body:
The "Categories" screen for the menu sections' order, photo, tax group and shown or hidden switch; "New category" or a row opens the form whose "Save" calls app.upsert_menu_category, and the order arrows call app.reorder_menu_categories.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /admin/coaches — Coaches
chunks.body:
The "Coaches" screen in three tabs (app.coaches_admin): Coaches ("Make a coach" through app.coach_promote; names, bio and photo through app.coach_update; branches through app.set_coach_branches, lesson types through app.set_coach_lesson_types, per-coach prices for the owner through app.set_coach_price, "Pause", "Resume" and "Retire" through app.set_coach_status; a coach not yet accepted reads "Waiting for the coach to accept"), Lesson types (drafts saved with app.upsert_lesson_type; for a manager a launched price shows "Propose a price", a launched length "Make a new lesson type…" and a draft "Put on sale", each price a price or promo change on /protocols) and Hours (weekly windows through app.set_coach_hours, time off through app.add_coach_time_off and app.cancel_coach_time_off).
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Coaches"; Management › Setup: "Coaches".

chunks.title: /admin/courts — Courts
chunks.body:
The "Courts" admin listing bookable courts in calendar order; "Add court" and "Edit" open a panel with names, photo, indoor or outdoor, booking lengths and an open switch saved by app.upsert_court, with "Switch off" (app.delete_court) and order arrows (app.reorder_courts).
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Courts".

chunks.title: /admin/day-close — Day close
chunks.body:
The day-close screen: when no trading day is open it shows an opening-float field and "Open day" (app.open_day); otherwise it walks the steps (settle open tabs, wait for tills to sync, count the cash, enter the card batch, then "Till shifts": each till and desk shift of the day with its difference, the money taken at a station with no shift open, and the refunds made that day for earlier days' payments, from app.till_shift_list) and "Close day" calls app.close_day, which ends any shift still open without a count, with "Export CSV" for the day's figures and shifts; an open shift, unpaid played bookings and "Checklists not finished" (the daily lists with a line nobody ticked, from app.checklist_day_state) warn but do not block. A "Money outside the drawer" card (app.day_close_online) shows deposits and match tickets; unpaid open-match bookings list their owing seats. The card adds the day's lesson money: online, kept, at the desk, refunds made today, refunds due and owed to coaches; a refund counts on the day it is made.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Day close"; Management › Financial: "Day close".

chunks.title: /admin/hero — Guest site
chunks.body:
The "Guest site home screen" builder choosing what sits above the guest menu ("Menu only", "Photo or video" or "Featured item"), the ticker lines and the bell tutorial switch; "Save" writes the cafe settings in one call (app.set_cafe_settings) and "Discard changes" reverts. For a manager the featured discount is read-only with "Change the discount" (a featured_discount price or promo change on /protocols) and, while one is stored, "Switch the discount off" (saves 0); while a discount is stored the featured item picker is off, and so is the Featured tile when the hero is not already in Featured mode.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Guest site".

chunks.title: /admin/hours
chunks.body:
The "Opening hours" page setting each day's open and close times and the closed dates; "Save" calls app.set_opening_hours, and the same editor is the first tab of /admin/settings.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /admin/loyalty — Loyalty
chunks.body:
The owner's "Loyalty" setup (app.loyalty_admin): "Loyalty is on", what earns a point and what one is worth, expiry and the member QR step (app.set_loyalty_settings); tiers (app.upsert_loyalty_tier, app.delete_loyalty_tier) and rewards (app.upsert_loyalty_reward).
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Loyalty".

chunks.title: /admin/menu — Menu / Menu prices
chunks.body:
The "Menu items" editor listing categories and their items with sold-out switches; "New category" and "New item" open forms that save through app.upsert_menu_category and app.upsert_menu_item, the arrows reorder with app.reorder_menu_items, and the switch calls app.set_item_sold_out. For a manager, "New item" in a café category is "Propose a new item", which opens a product release on /protocols; a launched item's sizes show their prices read-only with "Change the price" (a price change on /protocols) instead of "New size"; a never-launched café item's Active switch is off with "Goes on sale when the owner launches it", and a hidden shop product that was never on sale shows "Put on sale" (a shop_launch change). An item still in its product release is marked "In release" and its form names the release with "Open the release"; nobody can switch it on or change its prices here.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Menu"; Management › Financial: "Menu prices".

chunks.title: /admin/promotions — Promotions
chunks.body:
The "Promotions" list with a lifecycle filter, a search box and a per-row on/off switch (app.set_promotion_enabled); "New promotion" or a row opens the promotion editor whose "Save" calls app.upsert_promotion, and nothing is ever deleted. Only the owner saves a promotion or generates its code; a manager may switch a promotion off, and otherwise gets "Propose a promotion", "Change this promotion" in the read-only editor and "Switch on" beside a switched-off one, each a price or promo change on /protocols.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Promotions"; Management › Observe: "Promotions" (not a printed rail row).

chunks.title: /admin/qr — Tables & QR
chunks.body:
The "Tables & QR" screen listing cafe tables with zone, seats and a waiter-bell switch (app.set_table_bell); "Add table" and a row edit a table (app.upsert_cafe_table), "Print all cards" and "Print this card" print A6 QR cards, and "Replace" or "Replace every QR code" rotate tokens with app.rotate_table_token.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Tables & QR".

chunks.title: /admin/rates — Rates
chunks.body:
The "Court rates" screen listing rate rules by court, days, time window, prices and priority; "New rule" or a row opens the editor whose "Save" calls app.upsert_rate_rule and affects only new bookings, and a toggle shows or hides switched-off rules. Only the owner saves a rule; a manager reads them, with "Propose a new rate" and, on an open rule, "Change this rate", each a rate price or promo change on /protocols.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Rates"; Management › Financial: "Rates".

chunks.title: /admin/settings — Venue settings
chunks.body:
"Venue settings" in four tabs: Opening hours (app.set_opening_hours), Day & service (business-day start hour, waiter-call wait via app.set_waiter_call_cooldown, idle lock), Analytics (owner-only exclusions and engagement floor) and Venue details (name, phone, timezone through app.set_venue_details). Venue details also holds the online deposit and open-match panels (app.set_match_settings, owner only; the ticket price and the per-player limit apply to every branch). Venue details also holds the lessons panel (app.set_coaching_settings, owner only: lessons on or off, how lessons are paid (online only once the lessons terms are live), the coach's share, prices on the website and how many private lessons a coach may hold). A "Tournaments" panel holds the branch's one switch, "Tournaments at this branch" (owner, app.set_tournaments_enabled; off by default).
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Venue settings".

chunks.title: /admin/staff — Staff
chunks.body:
The owner's "Staff" screen listing accounts with role, PIN and status; "Add staff member" creates an account through the staff-admin edge function; opened from a hiring run's add_staff step (?hire=) a banner names the picked candidate and the role (app.protocol_step_detail, app.protocol_run_detail, app.hiring_candidates), "Add the new staff member" opens the form filled in with the role fixed, and the new account is sent as the step through app.submit_step, which finishes the run; "Manage" opens an editor (app.rename_staff, set_staff_role, set_staff_active, set_staff_pin, clear_staff_pin, set_station_staff for cover), and the breaks panel's "Save" writes break_allowance_minutes. Kitchen (prep) is retired: it is not offered for a new account or a role change (kitchen staff are Head barista, Barista, Assistant barista, Head chef or Chef), and an account still on it shows a "Retired" badge and keeps working until it is moved.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Staff".

chunks.title: /admin/suggested
chunks.body:
The "Suggested items" screen picking the "Goes well with" list shown under an item on the guest menu; add or "Remove" suggestions up to the cap, then "Save" (or "Discard changes") writes app.set_addon_suggestions.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /admin/telegram — Telegram
chunks.body:
The "Telegram" settings with "Set up" and "Sent messages" tabs: connection health from the telegram-diagnose function, "Send test message" (app.telegram_send_test), the group chat id and message language saved as cafe settings, and the people who may press the bot's buttons set with app.set_telegram_staff.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Observe: "Telegram" (not a printed rail row).

chunks.title: /analytics — Analytics
chunks.body:
A layout that validates the shared search params (range, custom dates, compare basis, court) and redirects to /analytics/courts, carrying the search along; the Courts and Cafe tabs switch between the two analytics screens.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management: "Analytics".

chunks.title: /analytics/cafe
chunks.body:
Owner-only Cafe analytics: Summary, What stands out, Menu, Sales and the guest menu, and Busy times, fed by app.analytics_daily_sales, _sold_items, _best_sellers, _bought_together, _item_margins, _price_bands, _promo, _menu_snapshot and _hourly plus PostHog guest data; the bar carries period, compare and the "Business day" and "Excluded items" settings, "Export" saves the figures, and the AI card's "Ask for findings" and "Check they still hold" call the insights function and save its results.
Roles: owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /analytics/courts
chunks.body:
Owner-only Courts analytics: Summary, What stands out, When courts are busy, Courts compared, Cancellations and no-shows, How people book, Guests, and Court players at the cafe, fed by app.analytics_courts_summary, _demand, _endings, _guests and _cafe for the period and its comparison window; the Summary names "Event hours" (courts held for tournaments, counted as open hours) when there were any; the bar sets range, compare basis and court, "Export" saves the figures, and tiles drill into transactions.
Roles: owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /assistant — Assistant
chunks.body:
The owner assistant: a full page with the list of chats, the thread, the context checkboxes with their pack sizes, and the usage meter; "Ask" sends a question (billed), "Stop" ends a streaming answer, "Run this job" accepts an estimate, and every answer lists the tools it read with a link to the page that shows the same numbers.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management: "Assistant".

chunks.title: /assistant/usage
chunks.body:
What the assistant has cost: tokens by kind (input, cache write, cache read, output) and cost per day for the month, month-to-date against the cap, and the price table each model is billed from.
Roles: owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /attendance — Late and early
chunks.body:
Late and early, for the manager and owner: records each person's minutes late and minutes left early for a work day (app.record_attendance, cleared with app.clear_attendance), lists a month's recorded days per person (app.attendance_month), and holds the branch's rule that a day with more than X minutes late and early together costs Y IQD off that person's wage (0 switches it off; a recorded day keeps the rule it was recorded under). Attendance is never read by the owner assistant.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Late and early"; Management › Financial: "Late and early" (not a printed rail row).

chunks.title: /deductions — Pay deductions
chunks.body:
Pay deductions, for the manager and owner: a head proposes taking money off a team member's pay from their phone and a manager proposes here, but only the owner decides, here or under Wages, never their own proposal or one against themselves, and an approved deduction comes off the person's next unpaid wage; "Waiting" and "All" list app.deductions_page, where the owner's "Approve" and "Decline" call app.decide_deduction (a decline needs a reason, which the proposer reads), a proposal the viewer sent offers "Withdraw" (app.withdraw_deduction) and a manager sees anyone else's as "Waiting for the owner"; "Month" steps through the months of app.deductions_month, one row per person opening to their approved and cancelled deductions, marked "Wage paid" once the owner paid that month, where the owner's "Cancel deduction" takes an approval back with a reason until then (app.cancel_deduction); "Propose a deduction" picks a person from app.deduction_targets and sends it through app.propose_deduction, and the owner's own entry ("Deduct from a wage") is recorded approved at once. Deductions are never read by the owner assistant.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Pay deductions"; Management › Observe: "Pay deductions".

chunks.title: /desk — Calendar / Bookings
chunks.body:
The desk calendar: a courts × half-hour grid for one day or a month heat view, where pressing a free slot opens the booking dialog (reservation.create → app.staff_create_reservation) and dragging a booking moves it (reservation.update → app.move_reservation); "New series" and "Block court" lead to their own screens. The booking dialog's "Open match" kind opens "Start an open match" (app.desk_start_match); match bookings show the organiser's name and a seat chip (app.desk_match_states); a day-view strip lists the night's filling open matches (app.desk_open_matches); booking a court warns when it would cancel an open match. The booking dialog's "Lesson" kind opens "New lesson" (app.desk_book_lesson, app.desk_create_group, app.desk_create_course, slots from app.coach_slots), also while lessons are switched off; lesson blocks name the coach and places (app.desk_lessons) and open only "Open lesson".
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Reached from: Court desk: "Calendar"; Operations: "Bookings"; Management › Observe: "Bookings" (not a printed rail row).

chunks.title: /desk/block — Block court
chunks.body:
The "Block court" form (court, date, from, to, reason); its "Block court" button creates a maintenance reservation (reservation.create), shows a conflict notice when the window is already taken, then offers "Open calendar" and "Block another". Opened from a tournament's courts step (?run=&step=) it is "Block courts for a tournament" instead: the plan's courts and times from app.tournament_context, each "Blocked" or "To block"; "Block N remaining" calls app.block_courts_for_event, which blocks them all as the tournament's event or, with a booking in the way, blocks nothing and lists what to move ("Open booking", "Check again"); then "Send courts step" submits the step with the blocks of the plan's windows and an optional note (app.submit_step). A plan sent back and moved has already given its old blocks back.
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Reached from: Court desk: "Block court".

chunks.title: /desk/customers — Customers
chunks.body:
Customer search that queries app.customer_search as you type; each result offers "Book" and "Open", "Create customer" goes to the new-customer form, and in attach mode "Attach to booking", "Attach to tab" or "Add to the match" hands the chosen customer back to the caller. A record's "Open matches" panel holds "Plays as" (app.staff_set_customer_gender), "Ban from open matches" (app.set_match_ban) and their matches; "Open-match tickets" (app.guest_tickets) offers "Cash out" (app.ticket_cashout) to managers. A record shows a "Coach" badge, "Make coach" for managers, "Book a lesson" and a "Lessons" panel (app.customer_lessons) with "Take payment" (app.lesson_settle); in attach mode "Add to the lesson" hands the customer back to a lesson.
Roles: court_desk, cashier, manager, owner.
Reached from: Court desk: "Customers"; Till: "Customers".

chunks.title: /desk/customers/new
chunks.body:
The "New customer" form (full name, phone, optional email, preferred language); "Create customer" calls the staff-gated desk-customer-create edge function, which creates a real guest account, and opens the new record, while "Cancel" returns to search; opened from an open match's Add player, it returns to the match.
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /desk/lessons/$id
chunks.body:
One lesson, group session or course session (app.desk_lesson_detail): "Move court" (app.desk_move_lesson_court), "Reschedule" (app.desk_reschedule_session), "Cancel lesson" or "Cancel the course" (app.desk_cancel_lesson, app.desk_cancel_course); the roster with "Arrived", "No-show" and "Undo" (app.desk_mark_attendance), "Take payment" (app.lesson_settle), "Cancel" a sign-up (app.desk_cancel_enrolment) and "Add student" (app.desk_add_student); for a manager, "Refunds due at the desk" (app.lesson_refunds_due) with "Refund" through the till's refund; then the history. Online only.
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /desk/matches/$id
chunks.body:
One open match (app.desk_match_detail): status, "Copy invite link", "Cancel match" while filling (app.desk_cancel_match) and "Open booking"; the "Players" panel with "Add player" (app.desk_add_seat), "Arrived", "No-show" and "Undo" (app.mark_match_seats), "Take share" (app.match_seat_settle), "Assign" of money taken on the bill (app.match_link_payment), "Write off" with a manager PIN (app.match_seat_write_off), "Remove" (app.desk_remove_seat) and "Call off" when a player is missing (app.desk_call_off_short); then the history. Online only.
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /desk/series/new — New series
chunks.body:
The "New series" screen for a repeating booking; "Check clashes" previews every date with app.preview_series, each clash is resolved with "Skip this date" or "Move to another court", and "Create series" writes the plan through app.create_series.
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Reached from: Court desk: "New series".

chunks.title: /desk/today — Today
chunks.body:
The "Today" board of arrivals, courts in play now and every booking today; "Mark arrived" writes app.mark_reservation, "New booking" and "Book this court" open the create-booking dialog, "Find customer" goes to /desk/customers, and "Take payment" opens the booking's bill; while the desk person has no shift open at the desk, "Start my shift" heads the board (app.open_till_shift). An "Open matches needing players" group lists the night's open matches with "Add player" (app.desk_add_seat), "Open" and "Start an open match"; on a match booking "Players" replaces "Mark arrived". A "Lessons today" group (app.desk_lessons) lists the day's lessons with places and what is still to pay, "Take payment", "Open" and "New lesson"; on a lesson's court row "Open lesson" replaces "Mark arrived".
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Reached from: Court desk: "Today".

chunks.title: /desk/tournaments — Tournaments
chunks.body:
The branch's tournaments for the next two months (app.desk_tournaments): when, format, players of the cap, the waitlist and status, each opening the tournament; one is published from its done protocol run ("Publish as tournament", app.tournament_publish). A tournament's court blocks on the calendar read "Tournament: <name>" and open it.
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Reached from: Court desk: "Tournaments".

chunks.title: /desk/tournaments/$id
chunks.body:
One tournament (app.desk_tournament_detail): "Cancel the tournament" for management (app.tournament_cancel) and its refunds due; Entries with "Add a walk-in" (app.tournament_add_entry), "Take payment" (app.tournament_settle), "Did not show" with or without a substitute (app.tournament_mark_no_show) and "Remove" (app.tournament_remove_entry); Rounds with "Start the tournament", "Next round" and "Regenerate from round k" (app.tournament_set_rounds) and each match's score, a correction asking why (app.tournament_score); Standings. Online only.
Roles: court_desk, manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /financial — Overview
chunks.body:
The Financial section's landing screen: a "This month so far" card from app.panel_headline (earned, cash, card) beside "Cash at recent day closes" read from day_sessions; "Open the management panel" goes to /panel, "Go to day close" to /admin/day-close, and the cards below open the section's screens. A "Coach pay" card counts the statements to approve and to pay.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Financial: "Overview".

chunks.title: /incidents — Incidents
chunks.body:
Incidents: the court desk and the cashier report an accident, an injury, a fight or damage here ("Report an incident": what kind, when, where, the court for a court, what happened, who was involved and photos uploaded through app.staff_media_slot, sent with "Send report" through app.submit_incident) and see "My reports" with the manager's note once reviewed (app.my_incidents); the manager and owner get To review, Reviewed and All from app.incidents_page, each report opening with its photos, where "Mark reviewed" saves a note the reporter reads (app.review_incident) and the owner's "Redact" replaces the report's text at once (app.redact_incident). Reports are kept a year and never read by the owner assistant.
Roles: court_desk, cashier, manager, owner.
Reached from: Court desk: "Incidents"; Till: "Incidents"; Operations: "Incidents"; Management › Observe: "Incidents".

chunks.title: /kds
chunks.body:
The kitchen display board: its live tickets, and those completed in the last two minutes, are read through app.kitchen_board with their lines, add-ons, notes and ready marks and no prices; per-ticket "Start", "Ready" and "Complete" buttons move the ticket through its statuses (ticket.status → app.set_ticket_status), ticking one item calls app.set_order_item_ready, and "Leave kitchen display" appears only for staff who hold another workspace. For the bar and kitchen roles a "My tasks (N)" button opens /tasks, N being their protocol steps to do (app.my_protocol_work) plus, for a head, the team's ideas to review (app.release_ideas_to_review).
Roles: prep, head_barista, barista, assistant_barista, head_chef, chef, manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /marketing — Marketing
chunks.body:
"Content for approval" heads the page: posts marketing sent for the owner's approval, Waiting, Changes asked, Approved, Closed or All from app.content_page, each opening every version with its caption, images and link (app.content_detail), where "Approve", "Ask for changes" and "Decline" call app.decide_content (the last two need a reason, which marketing reads) and the owner never edits the text. Below it, the owner's campaign list from app.marketing_overview showing status, window, audience and what each campaign brought in (or "Not measurable"); drafts the marketing role suggested (app.marketing_suggestions) are marked with who sent them, their note and photos, with a "From marketing" filter; a read-only "Requests to marketing" panel (app.marketing_requests_page) lists what staff asked marketing for from their phones, Waiting, Answered or All, with who asked, the item, the date wanted, the photos and marketing's answer; "New campaign" and "Edit campaign" save through app.save_marketing_campaign, per-row "Schedule", "Set live" and "End" confirm then call app.set_campaign_status, "New audience" writes app.save_marketing_audience, and "Open promotions" and "Open Telegram" link out.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Observe: "Marketing".

chunks.title: /observation — Overview
chunks.body:
The Observe section's landing screen: a "Waiting on you" list built from app.staff_requests_page, app.protocols_waiting_count, app.suggestions_page and app.marketing_overview with "Answer requests", "Open protocols", "Read suggestions" and "Review campaigns", the Live floor 3D plan, and screen cards fed by app.ops_overview. When a till shift closed short or over today, "Waiting on you" also offers "Open Day close" (app.till_shift_list).
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Observe: "Overview".

chunks.title: /observation/courts — Bookings
chunks.body:
A view-only "Bookings" board for a chosen day or month: a figure strip, one card per court right now, the night in two-hour rows and a month heat calendar, all read from reservations; "Refresh" re-reads, and pressing a booking opens a read-only panel whose only button is "Open in Court desk".
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Observe: "Bookings".

chunks.title: /observation/requests — Requests
chunks.body:
The owner's decision queue for leave, shift swaps, wage advances and record corrections from app.staff_requests_page, filtered by Awaiting decision, Decided or All; "Approve" and "Decline" open a dialog that calls app.decide_staff_request (a decline needs a reason), and a decision is final.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Observe: "Requests".

chunks.title: /observation/tills — Tills
chunks.body:
A view-only "Tills" board of the cafe floor for one business day: running, settled, voided and waiter-call figures, occupied and free tables, and lists of open, settled and void tabs read from tabs; "Refresh" re-reads, and a tab opens a read-only panel whose only button is "Open in Cashier".
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Observe: "Tills".

chunks.title: /ops — Today / Floor now
chunks.body:
The manager's "Today" screen, refreshed from app.ops_overview every 30 seconds: a "Needs you now" list with "Open the day", "Answer calls", "See which" and "Review expired", plus "Open protocols" for the protocol steps waiting on you (app.protocols_waiting_count) and "Open Goods in" for the driver's purchases to receive (app.purchases_to_receive); courts, cafe and stock cards with "Open bookings", "Open tabs" and "Open stock"; the day-close steps ending in "Go to day close"; exceptions, staff activity, and "Refresh". When a till shift closed short or over today, "Needs you now" also offers "Open Day close" (app.till_shift_list). A "Player reports" queue (app.match_reports_open) offers "Close report" and "Ban" (app.resolve_match_report); online refunds include ticket cash-outs, which any branch can settle. "Lesson refunds due" (app.lesson_refunds_due) offers "Refund" through the till's refund, up to what is due unless marked goodwill, and records a handback Qi could not take (app.lesson_blocked_refund_record, manager PIN); online refunds include lesson refunds.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Today"; Management › Observe: "Floor now".

chunks.title: /panel — Management panel
chunks.body:
The owner's read-only landing screen: app.panel_headline fills an "Earned" and "Taken in payments" band plus padel, cafe and losses figure rows for a chosen range and comparison, each figure opening its transactions through app.report_drill; "Export CSV" writes the window, every figure and every drill transaction to one file, and buttons open the Courts, Cafe, Revenue, Stock and Staff reports. An "Online money and open matches" group shows deposits, tickets and written-off match shares (ticket sales, refunds and liability for all branches); its rows open a report, not a drill. A "Lessons" group shows lesson revenue and what is owed to coaches.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management: "Management panel".

chunks.title: /protocols — Protocols
chunks.body:
Protocols: cards for New item, Tournament, Hiring, Price or promo change and Daily checklists, each showing how many are running and waiting on you with a Start button; Waiting on you, In progress and Finished lists from app.protocol_runs_page; a run opens its steps, records, photos and decisions (app.protocol_run_detail), a step's form submits through app.submit_step, Approve, Send back, Stop and Skip call app.decide_step or app.skip_step (a reason is required for the last three), Launch goes through the protocol-action function, and the owner-only How it works sheet saves app.save_protocol_template; the Daily checklists card (app.checklist_day_state) opens today's lists with who ticked each line and the photo of a line that needs one (app.checklist_board), and the owner's list editor, where any line can be switched to "Needs a photo", saves app.save_checklist_template; the New item card's "N ideas from the team" lists app.release_ideas_to_review, each idea opening with its photos, "Start as a new item" (the New item start, prefilled from the idea and carrying its photos) and "Decline" (app.decline_release_idea, a reason required); and the Recipe changes card lists app.recipe_changes_page, each request showing the recipe now and after the change with quantities and "Changed since it was sent" when it went stale, where the owner's "Approve" and "Decline" call app.decide_recipe_change and a manager only reads. A done tournament run offers "Publish as tournament" to management (app.tournament_publish), which opens the tournament at /desk/tournaments/$id.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Protocols"; Management › Observe: "Protocols".

chunks.title: /reports
chunks.body:
A layout with no content of its own that redirects to /reports/courts; the tab strip (Revenue, Courts, Cafe, Stock, Staff activity) shows the reports the current role and Management section may open.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /reports/cafe
chunks.body:
The cafe report (app.report_cafe, or app.report_compare): revenue, orders, average order, items sold, gross profit and margin and prep time with the "Show" views Best sellers, Cost & profit, By category and Waste, a "See waste" button that lists every write-off in the period, "Export", and item rows that drill their sold lines through app.report_drill.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /reports/coaches — Coach pay
chunks.body:
"Coach pay" (app.report_coach_statements): one statement per coach for a month with collected, court share, coach's share and to pay; a statement (app.coach_statement_detail) offers "Recount" (app.coach_statement_refresh), "Approve" (app.coach_statement_approve), "Void" (app.coach_statement_void, a manager PIN once approved) and "Mark paid" with a reference and a manager PIN (app.coach_statement_mark_paid). The money is handed over outside the till.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Coach pay"; Management › Financial: "Coach pay".

chunks.title: /reports/courts — Reports
chunks.body:
The courts report (app.report_courts, or app.report_compare): totals for bookings, booked hours, occupancy, court revenue, cancellations and no-shows, plus "Event hours" (courts held for tournaments, counted as open hours) as a figure and a By court column when a tournament held a court, with the "Show" views By court, Cancellations, Peak times, By start time and By day, a court filter and "Export"; a court or day row drills its bookings through app.report_drill. An "Open matches" view reads app.report_matches, with its own Category and Joining filters and no court filter or compare. A "Lessons" view reads app.report_lessons, with no court filter or compare; occupancy counts lesson time.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Reports".

chunks.title: /reports/revenue — Reports
chunks.body:
The owner-only revenue report (app.report_revenue, or app.report_compare when a comparison is chosen): headline figures grouped as Earned, Money taken, Given away and Tax, a day, week or month breakdown with the "Show" views Earned, Money taken, Given away and Tax, staff and payment-method filters, "Export", and pressing a figure or row opens its transactions through app.report_drill. Earned includes "Lessons" and "Owed to coaches".
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Financial: "Reports".

chunks.title: /reports/staff — Staff activity
chunks.body:
The staff activity report (app.report_staff_activity): one row per person with the "Show" views Activity, "Discounts, voids & refunds", Waiter calls, Day closes and Till shifts (every till and desk shift in the period from app.till_shift_list, in the order they started, with its count and difference; up to 62 days), a staff filter and "Export"; each row's "Audit" opens /admin/audit for that person, and rows drill their transactions through app.report_drill.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Management › Observe: "Staff activity".

chunks.title: /reports/stock
chunks.body:
The stock value report (app.report_stock): headline stock value plus counts for running low, below par, expiring soon and expired, with the "Show" views Running low, Below par, Expiring soon, Expired, Used and Count differences (with an "Only differences" toggle and a Product tests column); the expiring, expired and count rows name their store (cafe or bakery) and a count row has Moved; each list has a button opening the matching /stock screen, plus "Export".
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /setup — Overview
chunks.body:
The Setup section's landing screen: a "Worth checking" panel flags a broken Telegram link, managers or owners without a PIN, a single owner account, active accounts still on the retired Kitchen role (update every station first, then move each one to Barista or Chef), and prepared items with no par level (the kitchen's "What to make today" never asks for them), each with a jump button ("Open Telegram", "Set PINs", "Go to Staff", "Open Ingredients"), above cards opening the Setup screens. A "Coaches" card counts the coaches and the lesson types on sale.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Setup: "Overview".

chunks.title: /shop — Sell
chunks.body:
"Sell", the Touch Shop till on its own desk: a search box ("Search by name, SKU or barcode…"), the shop's section buttons and a grid of every size of every shop product (greyed "Out of stock" when none is on the shelf) feed a basket; a USB scanner's barcode adds the size straight to it; "Cash" and "Card" ring the basket up as one shop sale (tab.open kind shop → app.open_tab, order.add_items → app.till_add_items, no kitchen ticket, the stock taken from the shop store) and open the payment pane (tab.settle → app.settle_tab), where a shop assistant with no till shift open at this PC meets "Start my shift" first; the paid sale's receipt opens and prints. "Unfinished sales" lists shop sales rung up but not paid, each with "Take payment". Shop sales are paid on the spot, never on a table or a booking.
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Sell".

chunks.title: /shop/counts — Stock count
chunks.body:
"Stock count" of the shop store: "Start count" (app.start_count), the blind-entry table, "Finish count" (app.finalize_count) and "Discard this count" (app.discard_count), kept to the shop store; the shop assistant counts it on their own.
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Stock count".

chunks.title: /shop/drawer — Cash drawer
chunks.body:
The shop PC's "Cash drawer": the same screen as the till's, for the drawer of the till shift open at this PC ("Open drawer" records a reason with app.record_drawer_open; "Your shift" and "End my shift", app.till_shift_status, app.close_till_shift).
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Cash drawer".

chunks.title: /shop/products — Products
chunks.body:
"Shop products": "New section" makes a shop section (app.upsert_shop_category, never a café category), and the product list is one row per size of every shop product with SKU, barcode, price, on hand and supplier; "New product" writes app.upsert_menu_item then app.upsert_retail_variant, "Add size" and "Edit" write app.upsert_retail_variant, which keeps each size's own stock row (unit pc) in step. The shop assistant and the owner put a product on sale and change its prices directly; for a manager a new product is saved hidden and goes on sale through "Put on sale" (a shop_launch change), and a product on sale has its prices read-only with "Change the price".
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Products".

chunks.title: /shop/receive — Goods in
chunks.body:
Goods in at the shop desk: one delivery per submit into the shop store (no store to pick), shop products only, with supplier and notes; "Record delivery" posts it through app.receive_delivery, which puts shop stock in the shop store and nowhere else.
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Goods in".

chunks.title: /shop/stock — Shop stock
chunks.body:
"Shop stock": the On hand screen kept to the shop store and shop products only (v_ingredient_on_hand through the shop assistant's own reads), with each product's history drawer; no café or bakery stock, stock value or alerts.
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Shop stock".

chunks.title: /shop/suppliers — Suppliers
chunks.body:
"Suppliers": who the venue buys from (name, phone, notes, in use), picked on goods in and on shop products; "New supplier" and "Edit" write app.upsert_supplier, which refuses a second live supplier with the same spelling.
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Suppliers".

chunks.title: /shop/waste — Waste
chunks.body:
"Record waste" at the shop desk: a shop product, quantity, Spill or Spoilage and a required note, taken from the shop store (app.record_waste); no production here.
Roles: shop_staff, manager, owner.
Reached from: Touch Shop: "Waste".

chunks.title: /stock — Stock
chunks.body:
"On hand", the stock landing screen: a "Needs attention" list (running low, expired, sold past records, below par, expiring soon, counts from the phone to apply, staff additions with no cost, open alerts) whose buttons are "Show which", "Open expiry", "Open counts", "Open Goods in" and "Open alerts", a searchable on-hand table from v_ingredient_on_hand and app.report_stock whose venue total says, once the bakery store holds some, how much is in the cafe store and the bakery store (v_stock_by_location), with a Store filter, header buttons "Record a delivery", "Record waste" and "Count stock" (or "Continue the count"), and a per-row "History" ledger drawer with each movement's store.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Stock".

chunks.title: /stock/alerts
chunks.body:
Stock alerts from manager_alerts grouped by kind (sold past what was on record, naming the store the sale was at, expired, running low, expiring soon, offline sale not applied), each group with "Dismiss all" and each row with "Dismiss" (app.acknowledge_alert) and a jump such as "Count stock", "Open expiry" or "See what is low".
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/counts
chunks.body:
"Stock count", one store at a time ("Cafe store" and "Bakery store" tabs): "Start count" opens a count of that store (app.start_count), a blind-entry table follows (drafts saved locally, with a "Show recorded amounts" toggle), "Finish count" confirms and calls app.finalize_count, then opens Count differences, and "Discard this count" calls app.discard_count; "Counts from the phone" lists the kitchen's blind counts waiting for a manager (the sub-nav row shows how many), each opening its counted lines with what the records said when it was sent and the difference, editable, with "Apply count" (app.finalize_count) and "Discard" (app.discard_count).
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/expiry
chunks.body:
Expiry, from app.report_stock: an "Expired: throw out and write off" panel and an "Expiring soon: use first" panel listing batches with their store, quantity left, worth and date; "Write off" opens a manager-PIN and reason dialog that calls app.write_off_expired, and the header has "Export".
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/ingredients
chunks.body:
Ingredient master data (unit, supplier, pack size and price, shelf life, par, reorder point, yield, expected waste) from the ingredients table; "New ingredient" and per-row "Edit" open a dialog whose "Save" writes app.upsert_ingredient, and on-hand is a read-only figure linking to "Count stock".
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/margins
chunks.body:
Margins per menu item from v_item_margin: an "Items that earn too little" panel with "Show which" for "Sell at a loss" and "Margin under 30%", over a searchable Price, Cost to make, Margin and Margin % table; read-only, and the empty state links to Recipes.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/moves
chunks.body:
"Move stock": stock carried between the cafe store and the bakery store, with a first-day note to record what already sits on the bakery shelf as one move; the direction ("Cafe store to bakery store" or back), lines of ingredient and quantity (in its unit or in packs, with what the source store shows), "Add another ingredient" and "Move stock" call app.transfer_stock, which never changes the venue's total or its value; below, "Recent moves" of the last 30 days from here and the waiter's phone, with who moved what.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/receive
chunks.body:
"Goods in": "Bought by the driver" lists the driver's purchases still to receive (app.purchases_to_receive), and "Receive" opens one (?purchase=) prefilled with what was bought, where "Receive into stock" books its stock lines as one delivery through app.receive_purchase and "Mark checked" closes a line that is not stock (app.acknowledge_purchase_line); each purchase says "Delivered <time> by <name>" once the driver confirmed it reached the venue on the phone, or "Delivery not confirmed yet", and receiving never waits for it; "Added by staff" lists what staff added on the phone in the last 14 days (and anything older still without a cost) with the estimated cost and where it came from, "Needs a cost" first, and "Set cost" (per base unit or per pack) calls app.price_logged_stock; below it, one delivery per submit with "Put it in: Cafe store / Bakery store" (a store being counted takes nothing; shop stock is not listed here, it is received at the Touch Shop desk), supplier and notes and per-line ingredient, received and ordered quantities, cost per unit and batch expiry; "Add another ingredient" adds a line and "Record delivery" posts the whole delivery through app.receive_delivery. Receiving a driver's purchase asks the same store.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/recipes
chunks.body:
Recipes tabbed by Menu items, Add-ons and Prepared items with an All or No-recipe filter; "Add" or "Edit" opens a dialog where "Add an ingredient" adds lines and "Save" replaces the whole recipe atomically through app.set_recipe.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/variance
chunks.body:
"Count differences" for a chosen finished count (named by its store) from v_variance_report, defaulting to "Only differences" with a toggle to "All ingredients", with columns Records said, Counted, Difference, Sold, Expected waste, Recorded waste, Voids, Expired, Product tests (what a new item's test servings used, the product_test movements of a product release) and Moved (stock moved into or out of the store in the period); each row has "History", where a product test's note opens its release on /protocols, and the header has "Export".
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /stock/waste
chunks.body:
"Waste & production", two forms side by side: "Record waste" (the store it is taken from, ingredient, quantity, Spill or Spoilage, a required note) writes app.record_waste, and "Record production" (the store it is made in, the bakery store by default; prepared item, amount made) writes app.record_production, which consumes the components by recipe and reports the batch cost; below them "Made today" lists the business day's batches, from here or the kitchen's phones, with who made them (app.production_log_today).
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: /suggestions — Suggestions
chunks.body:
Suggestions: the staff suggestion box for the manager and owner; New, Seen and All from app.suggestions_page, each with its author's name and role; Mark as seen calls app.mark_suggestion_seen.
Roles: manager, owner.
Reached from: Operations: "Suggestions"; Management › Observe: "Suggestions".

chunks.title: /tasks — My tasks
chunks.body:
"My tasks", the protocol work of every hireable role but management (the driver's, marketing's and the waiter's landing screen, a rail row on the till and the desk, the kitchen board's "My tasks" button): To do, Waiting for a decision and Decided this week from app.my_protocol_work; "Open" shows the step (app.protocol_step_detail) with the tournament plan or the draft recipe it is about (app.tournament_context, app.release_test_context), its checklist (app.tick_run_item), what was sent before and why it came back, and its form, whose "Send" calls app.submit_step with photos uploaded through app.staff_media_slot, while "Withdraw what I sent" calls app.withdraw_step, "Withdraw the whole proposal" app.withdraw_protocol, and the court desk's courts step opens /desk/block instead. "Propose a new item" (head roles), "Price or promo change" (marketing, every kind but a shop launch, targets from app.price_promo_targets) and "Start a tournament" (court desk) call app.start_protocol; a head's "Ideas from your team" (app.release_ideas_to_review) opens each idea with "Start as a new item", which prefills the proposal and its photos, and "Decline" (app.decline_release_idea). "On your phone" shows read-only copies of the role's phone pages from the phone's own reads (checklists, what to make, the shopping list, purchases, marketing's take, drafts and results, requests to marketing, teachings, stock, recipes, recipe changes, ideas, vacation and requests, notes on new items, suggestions), the stock copy saying how much is in the cafe store and the bakery store and read by the waiter too, and "Today in the stores" (app.stock_today: the day's moves between the stores, what was added, driver deliveries still waiting for a manager and the phone counts), and a head's "My deduction proposals" (app.my_deduction_proposals: each proposal's person, date, status and the decider's note). Marketing also gets "Content for approval": the venue's posts for the owner's approval from app.content_page, each opening its versions (app.content_detail), with "New post" (app.submit_content, images uploaded through app.staff_media_slot, and optionally the menu item or campaign it is also about), and on a post "Revise" (app.revise_content), "Withdraw" (app.withdraw_content) and, once it is closed, "Send again", which starts a new post from it; from the kitchen board the page also offers "Back to the kitchen board".
Roles: cashier, waiter, court_desk, head_barista, barista, assistant_barista, head_chef, chef, driver, marketing.
Reached from: Court desk: "My tasks"; Till: "My tasks"; Team: "My tasks".

chunks.title: /till — Till
chunks.body:
The cashier's till: a search box, category strip and item grid feed a basket whose "Send to kitchen" posts the order (order.add_items → app.till_add_items), the active tab panel's "Cash" and "Card" buttons open the payment pane (tab.settle → app.settle_tab), and "New tab" (F6) opens a tab. A cashier with no till shift open here meets "Start my shift" at the top of the till before any payment, and in the payment pane if it is still not started ("That's right" confirms what the last shift left in the drawer, or "I counted a different amount"; app.open_till_shift), and someone else's open shift is closed first with a manager's PIN; a manager taking payment is told whose drawer it goes into; the question is skipped whenever the shift cannot be read, and never asked on a tab kept offline. The rail's "Start my shift" and "End my shift" (a count with no expected figure, signed with the person's PIN or a manager's, then the difference; app.close_till_shift, app.close_till_shift_for) sit under the break row, on the till and the court desk alike, and Sign out asks first while the person's own shift is open.
Roles: cashier, manager, owner.
Reached from: Till: "Till".

chunks.title: /till/drawer — Cash drawer
chunks.body:
The "Cash drawer" screen showing the opening float and today's drawer activity; "Open drawer" asks for a reason code and records the opening with app.record_drawer_open, and managers also see "Go to day close". The cashier's "Your shift" card says since when, what the drawer started with and how many payments, refunds and hand openings, with "End my shift", which counts and signs in the card's place, and never the expected cash before the count (app.till_shift_status); with no shift open, the "Start my shift" panel takes the card's place; managers see "Shifts on this till today" from app.till_shift_list, each with its count and difference.
Roles: cashier, manager, owner.
Reached from: Till: "Cash drawer"; Management › Financial: "Cash drawer".

chunks.title: /till/tabs — Open tabs / Tills
chunks.body:
The "Open tabs" board listing every tab on the floor with its age and running total; "Open tab" starts a new one, a row's "Open" jumps to the till with that tab selected, "Merge" combines two tabs (app.merge_tabs), and "Remove" cancels an empty tab (app.cancel_tab).
Roles: cashier, manager, owner.
Reached from: Till: "Open tabs"; Operations: "Open tabs"; Management › Observe: "Tills" (not a printed rail row).

chunks.title: /wages — Wages
chunks.body:
The owner's pay list for one branch and month (app.wages_month): each person's salary and pay day, the approved deductions and lateness penalties that come off it, the net, and whether it is upcoming, due, overdue or paid, with due and overdue wages also reminded on the rail and the panel (app.wages_due); the owner sets a salary and pay day (app.set_staff_wage), marks a wage paid or undoes that with a reason (app.mark_wage_paid, app.undo_wage_paid), approves or declines waiting deductions (app.decide_deduction) and deducts from a wage directly (app.propose_deduction). Wages are never read by the owner assistant.
Roles: owner.
Reached from: Management › Financial: "Wages".

chunks.title: /workspaces
chunks.body:
The "Choose a workspace" switcher, shown when an account holds more than one role; each workspace tile is a button that makes that workspace active and opens its home, with a "You are here" badge on the current one.
Roles: manager, owner.
Not a rail row: reached from inside another screen or by URL.

chunks.title: مساحة العمل: الصندوق
chunks.body:
مساحة العمل "الصندوق" تبدأ من /till.
الصفوف: الصندوق → /till; الفواتير المفتوحة → /till/tabs; الزبائن → /desk/customers; درج النقد → /till/drawer; الحوادث → /incidents; مهامي → /tasks

chunks.title: Workspace: Till
chunks.body:
Workspace "Till" opens at /till.
Rows: Till → /till; Open tabs → /till/tabs; Customers → /desk/customers; Cash drawer → /till/drawer; Incidents → /incidents; My tasks → /tasks

chunks.title: الصندوق: الزبائن
chunks.body: صف "الزبائن" في مساحة "الصندوق" يفتح /desk/customers. الاسم بالإنجليزية: "Customers". الأدوار: court_desk, cashier, manager, owner.

chunks.title: Till: Customers
chunks.body: Rail row "Customers" in the Till workspace opens /desk/customers. Arabic label: "الزبائن". Roles: court_desk, cashier, manager, owner.

chunks.title: الصندوق: الحوادث
chunks.body: صف "الحوادث" في مساحة "الصندوق" يفتح /incidents. الاسم بالإنجليزية: "Incidents". الأدوار: court_desk, cashier, manager, owner.

chunks.title: Till: Incidents

chunks.title: tool analytics_best_sellers
chunks.body:
The top-selling menu items in a range by units and revenue.
Kind: aggregate. Scope: cafe. Loaded on demand.
Same numbers on the page: /analytics/cafe.
Database function: app.analytics_best_sellers (through app.assistant_run_tool).
Arguments:
  from (date, required) — First business day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.
  to (date, required) — Last business day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).
  limit (integer 1..100) — How many items (default 10).
  basis (enum: settled | served) — Sales basis: 'settled' (paid tabs, the default the pages use) or 'served'.
Result: the result is itself the row array; id columns item_id get handles.

chunks.title: tool analytics_bought_together
chunks.body:
Pairs of menu items bought together in a range, with support.
Kind: aggregate. Scope: cafe. Loaded on demand.
Same numbers on the page: /analytics/cafe.
Database function: app.analytics_bought_together (through app.assistant_run_tool).
Arguments:
  from (date, required) — First business day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.
  to (date, required) — Last business day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).
  min_support (integer 1..1000) — Minimum times a pair must occur (default 3).
  limit (integer 1..100) — How many pairs (default 20).
  scope (enum: all | cafe | courts) — Which sales.
Result: the result is itself the row array.

chunks.title: table assistant_chunks
chunks.body:
0110. One searchable piece of text the assistant may cite: a system-map entry (page, nav, rpc, action, table, column, setting, enum, label, rule, doc, system) or a free-text row (note, request, alert, finding, rejection, menu_item, promotion). Written by the assistant-index edge function under the service role; read through app.assistant_search.
Created in migration 0110.
Columns:
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key
  kind text not null check (kind in ( 'page','nav','rpc','action','table','column','setting','enum','label','rule','doc','system', 'note','request','alert','finding','rejection','menu_item','promotion')) — What the chunk describes; the scope checkboxes map to kinds (catalog SCOPE_CHUNK_KINDS).
  ref text not null — Stable identity of the source: a route, a function name, table.column, or a row id.
  lang text not null check (lang in ('en', 'ar')) — en or ar. Map entries exist in both where an Arabic label exists.
  title text
  body text not null — The cleaned text (phones and emails already pseudonymised by the cleaning function).
  route text — Where the thing lives in the operator app, so an answer can link to it.
  embedding extensions.vector(1024) — 1024-dim embedding from the configured provider (voyage / openai / local zero-padded); null when the provider is none.
  tsv tsvector generated always as (to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(title, '') || ' ' || body)) stored — Generated: simple-config tsvector over title and body.
  source_updated_at timestamptz — When the source row or file last changed, so an answer can say how old a text hit is.
  indexed_at timestamptz not null default now() — When this chunk was last (re)written.

chunks.title: table assistant_component_cache
chunks.body:
0141. One generated answer of a component for one parameter set and one state of its inputs (plan §2.8). Served by app.analytics_component while superseded_at is null and expires_at has not passed. Written only by the assistant-component edge function through app.assistant_component_upsert.
Created in migration 0141.
Columns:
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key
  component_key text not null references assistant_components(key) on delete cascade
  params_hash text not null — md5 of the canonical parameters (app.assistant_params_hash): range, compare basis, scope, court, language.
  inputs_fingerprint text not null — sha256 of the cleaned tool results the answer read. Same numbers, same fingerprint, no new generation.
  content jsonb not null — The model's answer, shaped by the component's output_schema.
  sources jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb — [{name, args, row_count, ms, route, stats}] — every tool call behind the answer.
  gate jsonb — The number gate's verdict on the answer (plan §4.5).
  tokens jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — {"model", "input", "cache_write", "cache_read", "output", "cost_micros"} — what this generation cost; the card prints it.
  generated_at timestamptz not null default now() — When the model wrote it; the card always prints this line.
  expires_at timestamptz — Optional hard expiry; null means "until superseded".
  superseded_at timestamptz — Set when a newer generation landed for the same parameters or the edge function saw the numbers move. The card shows a superseded row greyed as "the last answer".

chunks.title: table assistant_components
chunks.body:
0141. An analytics card the assistant pipeline fills (plan §5.4): a fixed question, the catalog tools that answer it and the JSON schema the model must return. builtin rows are seeded by migration; pinned rows come from app.assistant_pin_component. Archived rows stay for their cache history.
Created in migration 0141.
Columns:
  key text primary key check (key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{2,63}$') — Stable id used by the page and the cache: cafe_findings, courts_findings, week_paragraph, what_changed, stock_watch, staff_note, or a pinned key.
  kind text not null check (kind in ('builtin', 'pinned')) — builtin (seeded) or pinned (owner pressed "Pin to Analytics" on a chat answer).
  question text not null check (length(question) between 1 and 4000) — The single user turn the model answers, in English; the answer is written in the page language.
  output_schema jsonb not null — JSON schema for output_config.format (strict: every property required, additionalProperties false). The card renders content against it.
  tools text[] not null check (cardinality(tools) between 1 and 12) — Catalog tool names (packages/core/src/assistant/tools.ts), each optionally followed by one space and a JSON object of fixed arguments, e.g. stock_view {"view":"expiring_soon","limit":50}. Range, compare, court and language come from the card's parameters.
  default_params jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — Parameters merged UNDER the request's: {"scope": "cafe", "compare": "previousPeriod"}. The page's own range always wins.
  created_by uuid references staff(id) — The owner who pinned it; null for built-ins.
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  archived_at timestamptz — Set by app.assistant_archive_component; the page hides archived cards.

chunks.title: table assistant_conversations
chunks.body:
0108. One owner chat with the assistant. scopes = the context checkboxes (plan §5.5); range = the date range the checkboxes read; handles = the short-id table (r1, c2, …) the edge function owns; tokens = rolled-up counts. Archived rows keep their messages.
Created in migration 0108.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  owner_id uuid not null references staff(id) — The owner account that opened the chat (staff.id = auth.uid()).
  title text — First 60 characters of the first question; the UI shows it in the list.
  scopes text[] not null default '{howto}' — Context scopes this chat may read: cafe, courts, money, stock, staff, customers, audit, marketing, settings, system, howto, docs, tables. Validated by app.assistant_set_scopes.
  range jsonb — Optional {"from": "YYYY-MM-DD", "to": "YYYY-MM-DD"} the context packs and default tool ranges use.
  handles jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — Handle table {"r1": "<uuid>", "c2": "<uuid>", …, "_next": {"r": 2, "c": 3}} — the edge function owns the format; the database stores it.
  tokens jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — Rolled-up token counts for the chat: {"input", "cache_write", "cache_read", "output", "cost_micros"}.
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
  archived_at timestamptz — Set by app.assistant_archive_conversation; the UI hides archived chats. Never deleted.
  model text — 0140. This chat's model, or NULL to follow venue_settings.llm_default_model. Must be a key of llm_pricing. Set by app.assistant_set_model; the edge function resolves the effective model per answer and stamps it on every assistant_calls row.

chunks.title: table assistant_index_queue
chunks.body:
0110. Outbox for the text index: one row per source change (kind, ref, op). Filled by the after-triggers below, leased by app.claim_due_index (60 s), deleted by app.assistant_index_done; failures keep the row with last_error for up to 5 attempts; tp_assistant_index_prune removes claimed leftovers after 7 days.
Created in migration 0110.
Columns:
  id bigint generated always as identity primary key
  kind text not null
  ref text not null
  op text not null check (op in ('upsert', 'delete')) — upsert (re-read the source and rewrite the chunk) or delete (the source row is gone).
  enqueued_at timestamptz not null default now()
  claimed_at timestamptz — Lease stamp: a row claimed within the last 60 s is skipped by the next claim and by the nudge.
  attempts int not null default 0 — Claims so far; rows stop being offered at 5.
  last_error text

chunks.title: table assistant_jobs
chunks.body:
0108. A proposed read over more rows than a chat turn may hold (plan §6). estimate holds the numbers the owner accepted; the state machine lives in app.assistant_job_transition (0112). Written by the assistant-job edge function under the service role; the owner reads it and may cancel.
Created in migration 0108.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  conversation_id uuid references assistant_conversations(id) on delete cascade
  message_id uuid references assistant_messages(id) on delete set null
  status text not null default 'estimated' check (status in ('estimated','accepted','running','reducing','done','failed','cancelled','over_estimate')) — estimated → accepted → running → {reducing → done | over_estimate → running | failed | cancelled}; estimated/accepted → cancelled.
  plan jsonb not null — The JobPlan the model proposed: question, list-tool calls without paging, extract and reduce instructions.
  estimate jsonb not null — The JobEstimate shown to the owner: rows, chunks, tokens by kind, the price at the time, assumptions.
  mode text check (mode in ('live', 'batch')) — live (runs inside the function call) or batch (submitted to the provider's batch API and polled by cron).
  chunks_total int — How many row chunks the plan pages through.
  chunks_done int not null default 0 — Chunks finished so far; the UI polls this at 2 s.
  tokens jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — Actual spend so far, four kinds plus cost_micros; over_estimate when it passes estimate × 1.25.
  result jsonb — The reduced answer object once done.
  error text — Why it failed, when it did.
  batch_id text — Provider batch id for mode = batch.
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  started_at timestamptz
  finished_at timestamptz

chunks.title: table assistant_messages
chunks.body:
0108. One turn of a chat. content holds the provider's content blocks verbatim (text, tool_use, tool_result, thinking) because the next turn must replay them unchanged; sources is the UI list of tool calls and cited chunks; gate is what the answer gate found (plan §4.5).
Created in migration 0108.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  conversation_id uuid not null references assistant_conversations(id) on delete cascade
  seq int not null — Position in the conversation, 1-based, unique per conversation.
  role text not null check (role in ('user', 'assistant')) — user or assistant.
  content jsonb not null — Provider content blocks, verbatim. Never rewritten.
  sources jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb — [{call_id, name, args, row_count, ms, route, stats, error?}] — every tool call behind this answer, so the owner can open the page with the same figure.
  gate jsonb — {status: ok|unverified, unverified: [{raw, value}], checked, retried} — the number gate's verdict on this answer.
  tokens jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — Token counts for this message: {"input", "cache_write", "cache_read", "output", "cost_micros"}.

chunks.title: table booking_payments
chunks.body:
0241, tickets since 0258, lessons since 0278. One online payment attempt (Qi Card hosted page): a deposit on a court booking (purpose deposit: venue_id, hold_id and reservation_id set), a purchase of open-match tickets (purpose ticket: a chain row, venue_id, hold_id and reservation_id NULL, ticket_count 1..3, amount = ticket_count x quoted_price_iqd), or a lesson place paid online (purpose lesson, 0284: venue_id and lesson_enrolment_id set, reservation_id NULL, hold_id the court hold of a private lesson). Written only by the app.deposit_*, app.ticket_* and app.lesson_* functions; request_id is what Qi gets, provider_payment_id what Qi answered. reservation_id is the booking a deposit is for (it moves when a swept hold is re-created as a booking); hold_id is where the attempt began and never changes. Not a till payment: no recorded_by, no day, not in the cash count.
Created in migration 0241.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  venue_id uuid not null default app.current_venue() references venues(id)
  reservation_id uuid not null references reservations(id)
  hold_id uuid not null references reservations(id)
  guest_id uuid references profiles(id) on delete set null
  purpose text not null default 'deposit' check (purpose in ('deposit'))
  provider text not null check (provider in ('qi', 'fake'))
  sandbox boolean not null default false
  request_id uuid not null unique
  provider_payment_id text unique check (provider_payment_id is null or char_length(provider_payment_id) between 1 and 200)
  amount_iqd iqd not null check (amount_iqd > 0)
  quoted_price_iqd iqd not null
  locale text not null default 'ar' check (locale in ('en', 'ar'))
  status text not null default 'created' check (status in ('created', 'pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'expired', 'refund_pending', 'refunded', 'refund_failed'))
  provider_status text check (provider_status is null or char_length(provider_status) <= 64)
  form_url text check (form_url is null or (form_url ~ '^https?://' and char_length(form_url) <= 2048))
  deadline_at timestamptz not null
  last_checked_at timestamptz
  succeeded_at timestamptz
  failed_at timestamptz
  expired_at timestamptz
  forfeited_at timestamptz
  failure_code text check (failure_code is null or failure_code in ('declined', 'auth_failed', 'bank_error', 'cancelled'))
  refund_reason text check (refund_reason is null or refund_reason in ('guest_cancel', 'staff_cancel', 'no_show', 'slot_lost', 'venue_offline', 'amount_mismatch', 'duplicate_success', 'manual', 'staff_refund'))
  refund_amount_iqd iqd
  refund_request_id uuid unique
  refund_provider_id text check (refund_provider_id is null or char_length(refund_provider_id) <= 200)
  refund_note text check (refund_note is null or char_length(refund_note) <= 300)
  refund_requested_at timestamptz
  refunded_at timestamptz
  refund_attempts int not null default 0
  cancel_attempts int not null default 0
  claimed_at timestamptz
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now() — Money moved exactly when these say it did (plan §3.2, I3).
  ticket_count smallint — 0258. Open-match tickets bought by this payment (1..3); NULL for a deposit.
  lesson_enrolment_id uuid — 0278. The lesson enrolment a purpose 'lesson' payment is for; NULL otherwise.

chunks.title: table incident_reports
chunks.body:
incident_reports (wave5-addendum §2.6, answer #6): accidents, injuries, fights and damage at the venue as staff report them, reviewed by MGMT. Immutable once filed. The text is replaced by a marker and the photos removed 365 days after the report (or at once on the owner's redaction). No guest link on purpose. Read by MGMT at the venue; the reporter reads their own through app.my_incidents. Never readable by the owner assistant or any LLM.

  place text not null — court, cafe, shop, outside or other.
  court_id uuid references courts(id) — The court, when the place is a court (and only then).
  place_detail text — Where exactly, as typed (at most 120 characters); emptied by the purge.

  people_involved text — Who was involved, as typed (at most 1000 characters); may name guests; emptied by the purge.
  photos text[] not null default '{}' — Photos: staff-media paths in the incidents folder (at most 6); emptied once protocol-action removed the objects.

  reviewed_at timestamptz — When it was reviewed.
  review_note text — The reviewer's note (1 to 1000 characters); corrections go here; emptied by the purge.
  purge_after timestamptz not null default now() + interval '365 days' — When the text and photos go: 365 days after the report, or the moment of a redaction.

A coach- or desk-typed name and phone are kept as typed and shown to staff and the coach (R44); a typed phone links an account only on a verified match, pending until that person confirms (link_confirmed_at, C-21). held (awaiting Qi) | booked | cancelled | expired.

chunks.title: table match_seats
chunks.body:
0258. The seats of an open match (seat_no 1..4). kind account (the player), friend (brought by guest_id) or desk (seated by staff: a walk-in named in guest_name/guest_phone, or a linked customer in guest_id). Each account or friend seat is backed by a ticket; a desk seat is vouched for by staff. Written only by the app.match_* definer functions.
Created in migration 0258.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id)
  match_id uuid not null references matches(id)
  seat_no smallint not null check (seat_no between 1 and 4)
  kind text not null check (kind in ('account', 'friend', 'desk'))
  guest_id uuid references profiles(id)
  guest_name text check (guest_name is null or char_length(guest_name) between 1 and 80) — 0258. A desk walk-in's name, typed by staff; NULL on every other seat.
  guest_phone text check (guest_phone is null or coalesce(app.phone_digits(guest_phone), '') ~ '^[0-9]{7,15}$') — 0258. A desk walk-in's phone, typed by staff; NULL on every other seat.
  gender text check (gender is null or gender in ('female', 'male')) — 0258. The seat's gender in a women's or men's match. Scrubbed on account deletion.
  status text not null default 'in' check (status in ('in', 'left', 'removed', 'cancelled', 'left_late', 'refilled', 'attended', 'no_show')) — 0258. in | left | removed | cancelled | left_late (left after booking, before start: its share stays open until refilled) | refilled | attended | no_show.
  ticket_id uuid
  share_iqd iqd not null — 0258. What this seat owes the court at the desk (its share of matches.price_iqd).
  request_id uuid references match_requests(id)
  replaces_seat_id uuid references match_seats(id)
  created_by_staff_id uuid references staff(id)
  vouched boolean generated always as (created_by_staff_id is not null) stored — 0258. True when staff seated this player (created_by_staff_id is set).
  joined_at timestamptz not null default now()
  ended_at timestamptz
  end_reason text check (end_reason is null or end_reason in ('left', 'removed_by_organiser', 'removed_by_staff', 'match_ended', 'refilled', 'banned', 'account_deleted'))
  marked_by_staff_id uuid references staff(id)
  marked_at timestamptz
  written_off_by_staff_id uuid references staff(id)
  written_off_at timestamptz
  write_off_reason text check (write_off_reason is null or write_off_reason in ('walked_out', 'staff_error', 'other')) — 0258. Why a manager forgave this seat's share: walked_out, staff_error, other.

chunks.title: table match_tickets
chunks.body:
0258. Open-match tickets, chain-wide: bought once online (booking_payments purpose ticket), reusable, lost only on a no-show. available | reserved (held by a pending request) | in_use (backs a seat) | forfeited (a no-show: revenue of forfeited_venue_id) | cashed_out (refunded to the card). Only Money inserts rows and writes cashed_out; every other move goes through the app.ticket_* helpers.
Created in migration 0258.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  guest_id uuid not null references profiles(id)

  purchase_payment_id uuid not null references booking_payments(id)

  request_id uuid references match_requests(id)
  seat_id uuid references match_seats(id)
  forfeited_venue_id uuid references venues(id)
  forfeited_seat_id uuid references match_seats(id)

  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()

chunks.title: table matches
chunks.body:
0258. One open match: a waits-for-four game on a free slot at a branch. No court is held while it fills (filling); at the fourth seat it is booked as a normal reservation (guest_id NULL, guest_name 'Open match') at price_iqd, split into shares_iqd (four shares, largest first, summing to the price). Ends played, no_show, cancelled, bumped (a normal booking took the last court) or expired. Written only by the app.match_* definer functions.
Created in migration 0258.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id)
  status text not null default 'filling' — 0258. filling | awaiting_court (four players, the last free court is only held by someone else's unpaid hold) | booked | played | no_show | cancelled | bumped | expired.
  start_at timestamptz not null
  end_at timestamptz not null
  period tstzrange generated always as (tstzrange(start_at, end_at, '[)')) stored
  duration_min int not null
  visibility text not null — 0258. public (listed to every guest of the branch) or link (reached only through share_token).
  join_policy text not null — 0258. open (a player joins at once) or approve (the organiser approves each request).
  category text not null — 0258. open, women or men (players declare their gender once).
  price_iqd iqd not null — 0258. What the court costs for this match, quoted at start; the booking is created at this price.
  shares_iqd bigint[] not null — 0258. The price split in four (largest first, sum = price_iqd): what each seat owes at the desk.
  rate_rule_id uuid references rate_rules(id)
  price_court_id uuid not null references courts(id)
  fill_deadline_at timestamptz not null — 0258. A filling match that has not reached four by this time expires (venue_settings.match_fill_deadline_minutes before start).
  share_token text not null unique — 0258. The secret in the invite link (22 URL-safe characters).
  organiser_id uuid references profiles(id) — 0258. The guest who runs the match; NULL for a desk-run match with no account organiser.
  organised_by text not null — 0258. guest (started in the app) or desk (started by staff for a walk-in or a customer).
  created_by_staff_id uuid references staff(id)
  reservation_id uuid references reservations(id) — 0258. The court booking, once the match is booked; NULL while filling or waiting, and always for a sandbox match.
  sandbox boolean not null default false — 0258. A match of the store review account: never books a court, never counts as money.
  deadline_warned_at timestamptz
  ended_at timestamptz
  ended_reason text — 0258. Why it ended: organiser_cancelled, staff_cancelled, reservation_cancelled, called_off_short, bumped, deadline, empty, venue_closed, no_court, all_no_show.
  idempotency_key text unique
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
