chunks.title: table order_slip_lines
chunks.body:
order_slip (Milestone 4b): one line read off an order slip, with the menu variant app.match_slip_lines matched it to. Replaced on every new reading; what was sent is the order's own lines. Read like its slip.
Created in migration 0238.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Line id.
  slip_id uuid not null references order_slips(id) on delete cascade — The slip.
  line_no int not null check (line_no between 1 and 60) — Its position on the slip, from 1.
  text_read text not null check (length(text_read) between 1 and 200) — The item as written.
  qty_read int check (qty_read is null or qty_read between 1 and 99) — How many, as written (1 to 99); NULL when no number was written.
  notes_read text check (notes_read is null or length(notes_read) <= 200) — What was written about the item for the kitchen or bar.
  flags text[] not null default '{}' — Checks raised on the reading: UNCLEAR (the model was not sure), NO_QTY.
  variant_id uuid references menu_item_variants(id) — The menu variant it was matched (or sent) as.
  match_source text not null default 'none' check (match_source in ('alias','trigram','manual','none')) — alias (a wording a cashier sent before), trigram (name similarity), manual (picked by hand), none.
  confidence numeric(4,3) check (confidence is null or confidence between 0 and 1) — How sure the match is, 0 to 1 (1 for an alias).

chunks.title: table order_slips
chunks.body:
order_slip (Milestone 4b): one photographed handwritten order slip. Filed by app.create_order_slip (the waiter, the cashier or MGMT), read by the receipt-scan edge function, sent to the kitchen by app.send_order_slip (which goes through app.till_add_items) or rejected. Read by the cashier and MGMT at the branch and by its uploader.
Created in migration 0238.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Slip id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The branch.
  storage_path text not null unique check (length(storage_path) <= 200) — The photo: a staff-media path in the slips folder (claimed as order_slip:<id>), read by its uploader, the cashier and management.
  uploaded_by uuid not null references staff(id) — Who took the photo.
  status text not null default 'uploaded' check (status in ('uploaded','reading','read','failed','sent','rejected')) — uploaded (waiting for a reading, or no model connected), reading, read (lines waiting for the cashier), failed (error_code says why), sent (on the tab as order_id) or rejected.
  error_code text check (error_code is null or length(error_code) <= 60) — Why the last reading did not produce lines: the codes of supplier_receipts.error_code.
  reading_started_at timestamptz — When the current or last reading started; one older than three minutes may be taken over.
  read_at timestamptz — When the last reading was stored.
  model text check (model is null or length(model) <= 100) — The model that produced the last reading.
  table_number_read text check (table_number_read is null or length(table_number_read) <= 20) — The table number as read off the slip, digits folded.
  table_id uuid references cafe_tables(id) — The table: guessed from the number read, then the one the order went to.
  tab_id uuid references tabs(id) — The tab the order was sent to.
  order_id uuid references orders(id) — The order app.send_order_slip created (one slip, one order).
  sent_by uuid references staff(id) — The cashier, manager or owner who sent it.
  sent_at timestamptz — When it was sent to the kitchen.
  rejected_by uuid references staff(id) — Who set it aside.
  rejected_at timestamptz — When it was set aside.
  rejected_reason text check (rejected_reason is null or length(rejected_reason) <= 200) — Why, as typed (at most 200 characters).
  created_at timestamptz not null default now() — When it was filed.
  reading_token uuid — scan_hardening (0240): the lease of the current or last reading (a scan_reads id); only it may store or end the reading.

chunks.title: table platform_settings
chunks.body:
0207 (multi-venue slice 2, MV5). The settings that belong to the whole chain, not one branch: currency, the chain's accounting timezone for the LLM budget, the per-guest hold cap, and every LLM budget and price-list knob. Exactly one row. Written only by owner RPCs (assistant_set_default_model, assistant_set_monthly_cap) and migrations.
Created in migration 0207.
Columns:
  id boolean primary key default true check (id)
  currency char(3) not null default 'IQD'
  timezone text not null default 'Asia/Baghdad' — 0207. The chain's day for the global LLM budget (llm_usage is keyed by date). A branch's own trading day uses venues.timezone.
  max_live_holds_per_guest int not null default 3 — 0207 (from venue_settings, 0048/C1). How many live holds one guest may have across every branch. Global because the guest is.
  llm_daily_request_limit int not null default 200 — 0207 (from venue_settings, 0079). Requests per chain day; 0 turns every LLM surface off.
  llm_monthly_cost_cap_micros bigint not null default 20000000 — 0207 (from venue_settings, 0079). USD micros per calendar month (chain timezone).
  llm_cost_micros_per_mtok bigint not null default 500000 — 0207 (from venue_settings, 0079). Blended fallback rate for a model absent from llm_pricing.
  llm_pricing jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — 0207 (from venue_settings, 0111). Model -> four rates in USD micros per 1,000,000 tokens.
  llm_default_model text not null default 'claude-opus-5' — 0207 (from venue_settings, 0140). The model a new assistant chat uses. Must be a key of llm_pricing.
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
  hold_strikes_since timestamptz — 0252: holds taken from this moment on count toward the hold ladder (app.hold_strike_apply). NULL switches the ladder off. Set to the migration time so no hold taken before the rule counts.
  match_ticket_price_iqd bigint not null default 10000 — 0257. The price of one open-match ticket, chain-wide (OM-46): 1,000..1,000,000 IQD in steps of 250, default 10,000. A change applies to purchases after it, never to tickets already bought (DF-21). Owner-set via app.set_match_settings.
  max_filling_matches_per_guest int not null default 3 — 0257. How many filling open matches one guest may be in at once, chain-wide (OM-37), 1..10, default 3. Owner-set via app.set_match_settings.
  match_terms_version text — 0257. The oldest accepted terms version that allows open matches (the 0153 format); NULL = any accepted version. Set by migration only, after a build carrying that CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION is on phones.
  lesson_terms_version text — 0277. The oldest accepted terms version (the 0153 format) whose Terms and Privacy carry the lessons section (R50). NULL (the default) = none is live yet: online lesson payment cannot be switched on (ONLINE_PAYMENT_OFF detail terms) and the online booking paths answer TERMS_REQUIRED; desk-paid lessons run. Set by migration only, once a build carrying that CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION is on phones (the match_terms_version precedent).

chunks.title: table profiles
chunks.body:
Created in migration 0004.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade
  full_name text not null
  phone text — captured day one per scope (future SMS identity)
  preferred_lang text not null default 'en' check (preferred_lang in ('en','ar'))
  expo_push_token text
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
  deleted_at timestamptz — Set by app.delete_my_account. The row is a TOMBSTONE: anonymised, retained only so reservations.guest_id and the venue statistics keep a parent. Never set by hand — the on_auth_user_deleted trigger reads it to tell a self-deletion (row survives) from an admin rollback (row is dropped).
  terms_version text — The Terms of Service / Privacy Policy version the guest last accepted (CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION in packages/core/src/legal.ts). Written only by app.accept_terms. Null = never accepted; the app shows its consent screen.
  terms_accepted_at timestamptz — Server time app.accept_terms recorded the acceptance of terms_version. Retained on the 0077 tombstone as proof the terms applied.
  payment_sandbox boolean not null default false — 0241. Set by hand on the store review account only: its deposits go to Qi's sandbox (test card, no money), are stamped sandbox and never count as paid or as revenue.
  given_name text — 0256. First name (1..39). Other open-match players see it; the desk and the guest see the whole name. Kept in step with full_name by profiles_sync_names; NULL on a deleted account.
  family_name text — 0256. Surname (1..39, NULL without a given_name). Other open-match players see only its first letter. NULL on a deleted account.
  gender text — 0256. female | male, asked once at the first open match (OM-28): women's and men's matches. Written only by app.set_my_gender and app.staff_set_customer_gender, with gender_set_at and gender_set_by. NULL on a deleted account.
  gender_set_at timestamptz — 0256. When gender was last set; set with gender.
  gender_set_by text — 0256. guest (app.set_my_gender) or staff (the front desk's correction); set with gender.
  avatar_path text — 0302. The guest's profile photo: an object in the private avatars bucket, <profile id>/<uuid>.<jpg|png|webp>. Written only by app.set_my_avatar; NULL = initials. Emptied by account deletion.
  birth_date date — 0302. Optional date of birth, 1900-01-01 .. today. Written only by app.set_my_birth_date, read only by its guest (app.my_birth_date; no column grant). Emptied by account deletion.
  phone_key text — 0303. app.phone_canon(phone) when the phone has 7-15 digits, else NULL. Kept by the zz_phone_key trigger; unique among live profiles (profiles_phone_key_live, 0304). No client grant.
  username text — 0307. The guest's public handle: lower case, 3-20 of a-z 0-9 . _, unique among live profiles (0308). Seen by other guests and staff. Written only by app.set_my_username; emptied (and held 90 days) by account deletion.
  username_changed_at timestamptz — 0307. When the username last changed; a guest may change it again 7 days after this. NULL until the first username.
  avatar_frame text not null default 'brand-green' — 0307. The ring drawn around the profile photo: one id of the closed list (app.frame_ids()). Written only by app.set_my_frame; back to brand-green on account deletion.

chunks.title: table promotions
chunks.body:
0067: promotion configuration (spec 06.26/06.27). Written only through app.upsert_promotion / set_promotion_enabled / generate_promo_code; never deleted.
Created in migration 0067.

chunks.title: table protocol_run_steps
chunks.body:
protocols_engine_tables (§2.6): a run's steps, snapshotted from the template at start. Status moves through app.protocol_step_allowed only.
Created in migration 0163.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Run step id.
  run_id uuid not null references protocol_runs(id) on delete cascade — The run.
  position int not null — Order in the run, from 1.
  step_key text — The built-in step, or NULL for an owner-added step.
  name_en text not null — Step name, English, as snapshotted.
  name_ar text not null — Step name, Arabic, as snapshotted.
  actor_roles staff_role[] not null — Who does the step. A manager may cover a step whose actors do not include the owner; the owner may cover any step.
  assigned_to uuid references staff(id) — When set, only this person does the step (a release's test is the proposer's).
  needs_owner_ok boolean not null — The owner decides; off, a manager at the venue or the owner. Taken from the def on a step whose OK is fixed.
  optional boolean not null — May be skipped with a reason by its decider.
  after_keys text[] not null default '{}' — The built-in steps this one waits for (from the def).
  status text not null default 'waiting' check (status in ('waiting','open','submitted','passed','skipped','stopped')) — waiting, open, submitted, passed, skipped or stopped.
  round int not null default 1 — Starts at 1; a send-back to this step (or below it) starts a new round.
  opened_at timestamptz — When the step last opened.
  passed_at timestamptz — When the step passed.
  skip_note text — Why an optional step was skipped (required when skipped).
  skipped_by uuid references staff(id) — Who skipped it.
  skipped_at timestamptz — When it was skipped.

chunks.title: table protocol_runs
chunks.body:
protocols_engine_tables (§2.6): one running protocol. Started by app.start_protocol, which snapshots the template and submits step 1 in the same transaction. Read by MGMT at the venue; everyone else through the definer reads, shaped by involvement.
Created in migration 0163.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Run id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The venue the run belongs to.
  template_id uuid not null references protocol_templates(id) — The template the run was started from.
  template_version int not null — The template version snapshotted at start; later template edits do not reach this run.
  kind text not null check (kind in ('product_release','tournament','hiring','price_promo')) — product_release, tournament, hiring or price_promo.
  variant text — Tournament only: type1, type2 or type3.
  title_en text — Run title as the starter typed it in English (staff may type one language; the owner types both). At least one of the two is set.
  title_ar text — Run title as the starter typed it in Arabic.
  status text not null default 'active' check (status in ('active','scheduled','live','done','stopped','withdrawn')) — active, scheduled (the last step passed for a date), live (a released item, until its day-30 review), done, stopped or withdrawn.
  started_by uuid not null references staff(id) — Who started the run.
  started_at timestamptz not null default now() — When it was started.
  scheduled_for timestamptz — The launch or apply date while the run is scheduled.
  live_at timestamptz — When a released item went on sale.
  finished_at timestamptz — When the run reached done, stopped or withdrawn; NULL before.
  stop_reason text — Why the run was stopped (required when stopped).
  menu_item_id uuid references menu_items(id) on delete set null — The item the run is about: a release's draft item, a price change's target.
  promotion_id uuid references promotions(id) on delete set null — The promotion a promotion change is about.
  data jsonb not null default '{}' — Kind-level fields written by the kind's hooks (a tournament's plan once it passes). Returned only to MGMT and the starter.
  photos_purged_at timestamptz — When a stopped or withdrawn run's photos were removed from storage (90 days after it finished).

chunks.title: table protocol_submissions
chunks.body:
protocols_engine_tables (§2.6): one piece of work sent on a run step, and its decision. Never edited: withdrawn, superseded by a send-back, or decided once. Earlier rounds stay as history.
Created in migration 0163.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Submission id.
  run_step_id uuid not null references protocol_run_steps(id) on delete cascade — The run step.
  run_id uuid not null references protocol_runs(id) on delete cascade — The run (denormalised for the run's reads).
  round int not null — The step's round when it was sent.
  submitted_by uuid not null references staff(id) — Who sent it (the actor, or a manager or owner covering).
  submitted_at timestamptz not null default now() — When it was sent.
  record jsonb not null — The step's form, as the kind's check hook normalised it (a note only for an owner-added step).
  photos text[] not null default '{}' check (cardinality(photos) <= 8) — staff-media paths attached, claimed through app.claim_staff_media (at most 8).
  withdrawn_at timestamptz — When the sender took it back before a decision.
  superseded_at timestamptz — When a send-back to an earlier step set this undecided submission aside.
  decided_by uuid references staff(id) — Who decided it (the sender for an automatic pass).
  decided_at timestamptz — When it was decided.
  decision text check (decision in ('approve','auto','send_back','stop')) — approve, auto (the sender decides this step), send_back or stop.
  decision_note text — The decider's note; required for send_back and stop.
  send_back_to uuid references protocol_run_steps(id) — The step a send_back reopened (this step or a passed step below it).

chunks.title: table protocol_template_items
chunks.body:
protocols_engine_tables (§2.6): a template step's checklist, copied into each new run.
Created in migration 0163.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Template item id.
  step_id uuid not null references protocol_template_steps(id) on delete cascade — The template step.
  position int not null — Order in the checklist, from 1.
  text_en text not null check (coalesce(length(btrim(text_en)),0) > 0) — Checklist line, English.
  text_ar text not null check (coalesce(length(btrim(text_ar)),0) > 0) — Checklist line, Arabic.

chunks.title: table protocol_template_steps
chunks.body:
protocols_engine_tables (§2.6): a template's ordered steps. step_key names a built-in step of app.protocol_step_defs (fixed actors, optional flag and dependencies); NULL is the owner's own step.
Created in migration 0163.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Template step id.
  template_id uuid not null references protocol_templates(id) on delete cascade — The template.
  position int not null check (position >= 1) — Order in the template, from 1. A built-in step comes after its dependencies; the first and last built-in steps keep their places.
  step_key text — The built-in step (app.protocol_step_defs), or NULL for a step the owner added.
  name_en text not null check (coalesce(length(btrim(name_en)),0) > 0) — Step name, English (the owner may rename a built-in step).
  name_ar text not null check (coalesce(length(btrim(name_ar)),0) > 0) — Step name, Arabic.
  actor_roles staff_role[] not null check (cardinality(actor_roles) >= 1) — Who does the step. Fixed for a built-in step; the owner's pick among the hireable roles for their own.
  needs_owner_ok boolean not null default false — "Needs my OK": the owner decides the step; off, a manager at the venue (or the owner) decides. Fixed where the def says ok_fixed.
  optional boolean not null default false — An optional step may be skipped with a reason by its decider. Fixed for a built-in step.

chunks.title: table protocol_templates
chunks.body:
protocols_engine_tables (§2.6): one template per venue, kind and tournament variant, the steps a new run of that kind snapshots. Edited by the owner through app.save_protocol_template (How it works); seeded by app.protocol_seed_venue. Read by MGMT at the venue.
Created in migration 0163.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Template id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The venue the template belongs to; runs start from their venue's template.
  kind text not null check (kind in ('product_release','tournament','hiring','price_promo')) — product_release, tournament, hiring or price_promo.
  variant text check (variant in ('type1','type2','type3')) — Tournament only: type1, type2 (community) or type3 (sponsor or client); NULL for every other kind.
  name_en text not null check (coalesce(length(btrim(name_en)),0) > 0) — Template name, English.
  name_ar text not null check (coalesce(length(btrim(name_ar)),0) > 0) — Template name, Arabic.
  version int not null default 1 — Bumped by every save; runs record the version they started from, and a save with a stale version is refused TEMPLATE_CHANGED.
  updated_by uuid references staff(id) — The owner who saved it last; NULL for the seed.
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now() — When it was last saved.

chunks.title: table purchase_lines
chunks.body:
shopping_purchases (§2.15): what one purchase bought, line by line, and what each cost. A stock line's quantity is in the ingredient's base unit. Read by MGMT at the venue and by the purchase's buyer.
Created in migration 0166.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Purchase line id.

  price_iqd iqd not null — What this line cost, in IQD. Receiving books price ÷ quantity as the cost per base unit.
  status text not null default 'to_receive' check (status in ('to_receive','received','acknowledged')) — to_receive, received (booked into stock) or acknowledged (not stock).

chunks.title: table purchases
chunks.body:
shopping_purchases (§2.15): one shop visit by the driver (or a manager): where, when, the total paid and the receipt photo. Recorded by app.record_purchase; received into stock by app.receive_purchase, which links the delivery. Never touches the till, the drawer or day close. Read by MGMT at the venue, and by the staff member who made it.
Created in migration 0166.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Purchase id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The venue the purchase was for.
  staff_id uuid not null references staff(id) — Who bought it (the driver, or a manager).
  bought_at timestamptz not null — When it was bought.
  shop_name text check (shop_name is null or length(shop_name) <= 80) — Where it was bought, as typed (at most 80 characters); suppliers stay management's.
  total_iqd iqd not null — What the receipt came to, in IQD. Paying the driver back happens outside the system.
  receipt_path text — The receipt photo: a staff-media path in the receipts folder, read by its uploader and management only.
  status text not null default 'to_receive' check (status in ('to_receive','done')) — to_receive until every line is received or acknowledged, then done.
  delivery_id uuid references deliveries(id) — The delivery app.receive_purchase booked its stock lines into (one purchase, one delivery).
  received_by uuid references staff(id) — The manager or owner who received it.
  received_at timestamptz — When it was received.
  created_at timestamptz not null default now() — When it was recorded.
  delivered_at timestamptz — purchase_delivery_confirm (§2.24.10): when the buyer (or a manager) confirmed the purchase was delivered to the venue; NULL until then. Receiving never waits for it.
  delivered_by uuid — Who confirmed the delivery: the buyer, or a manager or the owner.

chunks.title: table rate_rule_prices
chunks.body:

An approved deduction comes off the person's wage in its pay month (wages, 0270). Read by MGMT at the venue; the proposer and the person read through RPCs. chunks.title: table staff_attendance
chunks.body:
staff_attendance (0270): a manager or the owner records how late a person arrived and how early they left on a work day at a branch. The day costs penalty_rule_iqd when the minutes together exceed grace_minutes, both copied from the branch's rule (attendance_grace_minutes, attendance_penalty_iqd) when recorded. It comes off the wage of pay_month: the work day's month, or the person's next unpaid month when that one was already paid. Read by MGMT at the branch, never a row about themselves. Never readable by the owner assistant or any LLM.
Created in migration 0270.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Row id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The branch.
  staff_id uuid not null references staff(id) — The person.
  work_date date not null — The work day.
  late_minutes int not null default 0 — Minutes late, 0 to 720.
  early_leave_minutes int not null default 0 — Minutes left early, 0 to 720.
  grace_minutes int not null — The rule's X when recorded: more minutes than this costs the penalty.
  penalty_rule_iqd iqd not null — The rule's Y when recorded: the penalty for a day over X; 0 = the rule was off.
  penalty_iqd bigint generated always as ( case when penalty_rule_iqd > 0 and late_minutes + early_leave_minutes > grace_minutes then penalty_rule_iqd else 0 end) stored — What the day costs: penalty_rule_iqd when late + early minutes exceed grace_minutes, else 0.
  pay_month date not null — The pay month it comes off (the first day of that month).
  note text — An optional note (at most 300 characters).
  recorded_by uuid not null references staff(id) — The manager or owner who recorded it.
  recorded_at timestamptz not null default now() — When it was recorded or last changed.

chunks.title: table supplier_receipt_lines
chunks.body:
receipt_scan (Milestone 4b): one line the model read off a receipt, with the stock ingredient app.match_receipt_lines matched it to. Replaced on every new reading; the manager's final lines go to the delivery, not here. Read like its receipt.
Created in migration 0236.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Line id.
  receipt_id uuid not null references supplier_receipts(id) on delete cascade — The receipt it was read from.
  line_no int not null check (line_no between 1 and 200) — Its position on the receipt, from 1.
  text_read text not null check (length(text_read) between 1 and 200) — The item wording as printed (at most 200 characters).
  qty_read numeric(12,3) check (qty_read is null or qty_read > 0) — The quantity as printed, in the receipt's own unit.
  unit_read text check (unit_read is null or length(unit_read) <= 20) — The receipt's unit as printed (kg, box, pc…), not a stock unit.
  unit_price_iqd_read iqd — The unit price as printed, in IQD.
  line_total_iqd_read iqd — The line total as printed, in IQD.
  expiry_read date — An expiry date printed on the line, if any.
  flags text[] not null default '{}' — Checks the edge function raised on the reading: ARITHMETIC (qty x price is not the total), NO_PRICE, TOTAL_MISMATCH, UNCLEAR (the model was not sure: handwriting), SMALL_AMOUNT (a price under 250 IQD: thousands shorthand?), TRUNCATED (the last line kept; the paper had more). Unknown flags are dropped (0240).
  ingredient_id uuid references ingredients(id) — The stock ingredient it was matched (or confirmed) to.
  match_source text not null default 'none' check (match_source in ('alias','trigram','manual','none')) — alias (a wording a manager confirmed before), trigram (name similarity), manual (the manager picked it), none.
  confidence numeric(4,3) check (confidence is null or confidence between 0 and 1) — How sure the match is, 0 to 1 (1 for an alias).

chunks.title: table supplier_receipts
chunks.body:
receipt_scan (Milestone 4b): one photographed supplier receipt. Filed by app.create_receipt (driver or MGMT), read by the receipt-scan edge function (a model behind _shared/receipts/connect.ts), confirmed into ONE delivery by app.confirm_receipt or rejected. Read by MGMT at the branch and by its uploader.
Created in migration 0236.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Receipt id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The branch the receipt is for.
  storage_path text not null unique check (length(storage_path) <= 200) — The photo: a staff-media path in the receipts folder (claimed as receipt:<id>), read by its uploader and management only.
  source text not null check (source in ('phone','operator')) — Where the photo came from: phone (the staff phone) or operator (a file on Goods in).
  uploaded_by uuid not null references staff(id) — Who filed it.
  status text not null default 'uploaded' check (status in ('uploaded','reading','read','failed','confirmed','rejected')) — uploaded (waiting for a reading, or no model connected), reading, read (lines waiting for review), failed (the model could not read it; error_code says why), confirmed (booked as delivery_id) or rejected.
  error_code text check (error_code is null or length(error_code) <= 60) — Why the last reading did not produce lines: READER_NOT_CONFIGURED, UNREADABLE, UPSTREAM, TIMEOUT, RATE_LIMITED, NOT_CONFIGURED, TRUNCATED, LLM_MONTHLY_CAP, LLM_DAILY_QUOTA, INVALID_READING, PHOTO_MISSING, STORE_FAILED, READ_ABANDONED (0240). On a read receipt: why the last re-read failed (its lines are the earlier reading).
  reading_started_at timestamptz — When the current or last reading started; a reading older than three minutes may be taken over.
  read_at timestamptz — When the last reading was stored.
  model text check (model is null or length(model) <= 100) — The model that produced the last reading.
  supplier_name_read text check (supplier_name_read is null or length(supplier_name_read) <= 120) — The supplier name as the model read it off the receipt.
  supplier_id uuid references suppliers(id) — The supplier: guessed from the name read, then the one the manager confirmed with.
  receipt_date date — The date printed on the receipt, as read.
  total_iqd_read iqd — The receipt total in IQD, as read.
  delivery_id uuid references deliveries(id) — The delivery app.confirm_receipt booked (one receipt, one delivery).
  confirmed_by uuid references staff(id) — The manager or owner who confirmed it.
  confirmed_at timestamptz — When it was confirmed.
  rejected_by uuid references staff(id) — The manager or owner who rejected it.
  rejected_at timestamptz — When it was rejected.
  rejected_reason text check (rejected_reason is null or length(rejected_reason) <= 200) — Why it was rejected, as typed (at most 200 characters).
  created_at timestamptz not null default now() — When it was filed.
  reading_token uuid — scan_hardening (0240): the lease of the current or last reading (a scan_reads id); only it may store or end the reading.

chunks.title: table till_shifts
chunks.body:
till_shifts (wave 5 §2.9, Majed #4): one person's drawer at one station inside one open day. Opened by app.open_till_shift on a counted float (with the handover difference from the station's last counted shift of the day), closed by app.close_till_shift (own PIN), app.close_till_shift_for (a manager's PIN grant) or with the day (close_day, and open_till_shift's self-heal). Payments and refunds are stamped with the shift open at their station (app.stamp_till_shift). Open means closed_at is null. Read by MGMT at the venue; everyone else reads through app.till_shift_status. No client write grant.
Created in migration 0205.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Shift id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The venue: the station's.
  day_session_id uuid not null references day_sessions(id) — The business day the shift belongs to (open when the shift opened).
  station_id text not null — The till or desk station whose drawer this is (with venue_id, a stations pair key).
  staff_id uuid not null references staff(id) — Whose shift it is: the person who opened it.
  opened_at timestamptz not null default now() — When the shift opened.
  opening_float_iqd iqd not null — The cash counted into the drawer at the open, IQD.
  open_note text — An optional note typed at the open (at most 500 characters). Never readable by the owner assistant.
  handover_from_shift_id uuid references till_shifts(id) — The station's last counted shift of the same day, when there was one; null on a day's first shift at the station.
  handover_difference_iqd iqd_signed — opening_float_iqd minus (that shift's count plus the cash taken in or paid out at the station with no shift open since, V18), IQD, signed. Null without a handover.
  closed_at timestamptz — When the shift closed; null while it is open.
  closed_by uuid references staff(id) — Who closed it: the person at the till, or the manager whose close_day or open ended it.
  closed_via text — own_pin (the holder's own PIN), manager_pin (a manager's PIN grant) or day_close (ended with its day, uncounted).
  authorized_by uuid references staff(id) — Who signed the count: the holder for own_pin, the manager for manager_pin; null for day_close.
  cash_payments_iqd iqd — Stamped at the close: cash payments carrying this shift, IQD.
  cash_refunds_iqd iqd — Stamped at the close: refunds carrying this shift whose payment was cash, IQD.
  cash_expected_iqd iqd_signed — Stamped at the close: opening float + cash payments - cash refunds, IQD, signed.
  cash_counted_iqd iqd — The blind count at the close, IQD; null when the shift ended with its day.
  cash_variance_iqd iqd_signed — cash_counted_iqd - cash_expected_iqd, IQD, signed; null when uncounted.
  card_payments_iqd iqd — Stamped at the close: card payments carrying this shift, IQD.
  card_refunds_iqd iqd — Stamped at the close: refunds carrying this shift whose payment was card, IQD.
  payment_count int — Stamped at the close: payments carrying this shift.
  refund_count int — Stamped at the close: refunds carrying this shift.
  drawer_open_count int — Stamped at the close: drawer.open audit rows from the station inside the shift. Shown only, never in the math.
  close_note text — An optional note typed at the close (at most 500 characters). Never readable by the owner assistant.

chunks.title: table tournaments
chunks.body:
Tournaments (M7, build contracts §1.2). One published tournament per protocol run of kind tournament (tournament_publish adopts the run's event blocks). Americano or Mexicano, individual entry. status open -> closed (the cut-off, enough entries) -> running (the first set_rounds) -> finished; cancelled from open, closed or running (cancel_reason under_filled from the sweep, staff from tournament_cancel). revision moves on every play write (rounds, scores, no-shows, entries added or removed once closed): the desk sends it back as based_on_revision. No client grant: every read and write is a definer RPC.
Created in migration 0299.

chunks.body:
0006, per branch since 0208. One row per venue: opening hours, closed dates, booking and degraded-mode thresholds, guest cafe limits, tax and rounding. The chain's settings live in platform_settings (0207).
Created in migration 0006.
Columns:
  id boolean primary key default true check (id) — DEPRECATED 0208: the 0006 singleton key. Always true; no longer unique. Kept so a body not yet re-issued still compiles. Never use it in new code: key by venue_id.
  venue_name text not null
  currency char(3) not null default 'IQD'
  timezone text not null default 'Asia/Baghdad'
  opening_hours jsonb not null — {"mon":[["09:00","23:00"]],...} config blob
  closed_dates date[] not null default '{}'
  hold_ttl_seconds int not null default 300
  protected_horizon_hours int not null default 48 — degraded-mode lockout window
  heartbeat_stale_seconds int not null default 45 — till POSTs every 10s; stale past this
  table_token_ttl_minutes int not null default 90 — guest session inactivity expiry
  waiter_call_cooldown_seconds int not null default 120
  cancellation_window_hours int not null default 12
  cash_rounding_iqd int not null default 1 — 1 = no rounding (override #1)
  expiring_soon_days int not null default 3
  tax_inclusive boolean not null default false
  phone text
  max_live_holds_per_guest int not null default 3 — 0048/C1: cap on unexpired pending holds per auth.uid(). 0 disables the cap.
  max_booking_horizon_days int not null default 180 — 0048/C1: how far ahead a guest may hold a slot. 0 disables the horizon. Default 180 is deliberately generous -- it exists to bound the C1 abuse (holds arbitrarily far out, forever), not to shorten the venue booking window; max_live_holds_per_guest is the tight constraint. Tighten here if Touch wants a shorter window.
  llm_daily_request_limit int not null default 200 — DEPRECATED 0207: moved to platform_settings; no function reads it. Dropped by a later migration.
  llm_monthly_cost_cap_micros bigint not null default 20000000 — DEPRECATED 0207: moved to platform_settings; no function reads it. Dropped by a later migration.
  llm_cost_micros_per_mtok bigint not null default 500000 — DEPRECATED 0207: moved to platform_settings; no function reads it. Dropped by a later migration.
  guest_orders_per_minute int not null default 6 — 0082/SEC-25. Orders one guest table session may submit per rolling minute. 6 is generous for a real table — a group ordering in waves — and far below what a script does. 0 disables guest ordering entirely.
  guest_items_per_order int not null default 40 — 0082/SEC-25. Line items in a single guest order. 40 covers a large table; it stops one request queueing hundreds of tickets.
  tab_confirm_threshold_iqd bigint not null default 150000 — 0082/SEC-25. Tab value above which the TILL asks staff to confirm before adding more. Advisory: read by the operator UI, not enforced here — a genuine large tab must never be blocked by the database mid-service.
  llm_pricing jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb — DEPRECATED 0207: moved to platform_settings; no function reads it. Dropped by a later migration.
  venue_id uuid — 0126, key since 0208 (unique index venue_settings_venue_id_key; not null by the validated CHECK venue_settings_venue_id_present of 0139). One row per branch.
  llm_default_model text not null default 'claude-opus-5' — DEPRECATED 0207: moved to platform_settings; no function reads it. Dropped by a later migration.
  deposit_mode text not null default 'off' — 0241. Online deposit on guest bookings: off (never asked), optional (Pay now or pay at the desk), required (pay first). Owner-set via app.set_deposit_settings. Ships off.
  deposit_percent_bp int not null default 5000 — 0241. Deposit as basis points of the court price (5000 = 50 %), rounded up to 250 IQD, then held between deposit_min_iqd and deposit_max_iqd and never above the price.
  deposit_min_iqd bigint not null default 10000
  deposit_max_iqd bigint
  deposit_window_seconds int not null default 900 — 0241. How long a guest has on the payment page; the hold is extended to cover it.
  deposit_forfeit_no_show boolean not null default true — 0241. A no-show keeps the deposit (true) or refunds it (false). A cancelled booking always refunds.
  offline_mode_enabled boolean not null default false — 0248. Offline (degraded) mode for this branch. False: app.is_degraded is always false (the owner's default). Owner-writable via app.set_venue_details.
  matches_enabled boolean not null default false — 0257. Open matches at this branch. False (the default, every branch): no new match starts and no new player joins; matches already filling or booked carry on (R10). Owner-set via app.set_match_settings.
  match_fill_deadline_minutes int not null default 120 — 0257. An open match must fill this many minutes before its start (OM-22), 60..2880, default 120. A match can start only at least this plus 60 minutes ahead (OM-43). Applies to matches started after a change. Owner-set via app.set_match_settings.
  coaching_enabled boolean not null default false — 0277. Lessons at this branch. False (the default, every branch): no new guest or coach booking, join, add or creation (COACHING_OFF); lessons already booked run to their end; coach mode and the desk keep working (R45, R51). Owner-set via app.set_coaching_settings.
  lesson_payment_mode text not null default 'desk' — 0277. How guests pay for a lesson they book (CD-1): desk (the default), online_optional or online_required (Qi). Bookings made by a coach or the desk are always paid at the desk. An online mode needs platform_settings.lesson_terms_version (C-26, R50). Owner-set via app.set_coaching_settings.
  coach_share_bp int not null default 6000 — 0277. The coach's share of collected lesson money less the court share, in basis points (CD-5, C-6): 0..10000, default 6000 (60 %). Snapshotted on every lesson and course at creation. Owner only; never in venue_settings_public. 0297 (DB-46): no client column grant; managers and the owner read it through app.coaching_settings, and the owner assistant never reads it (C-28, D1).
  lesson_prices_public boolean not null default false — 0277. Whether the website's /coaching page shows lesson prices (C-11). Presentation, not secrecy: the app shows prices to anyone. Default false until the owner agrees. Owner-set via app.set_coaching_settings.
  coach_max_open_private int not null default 10 — 0277. How many upcoming coach-booked private lessons one coach may hold at this branch (C-24, R56): 1..100, default 10 (COACH_ADD_LIMIT detail live). Owner-set via app.set_coaching_settings. 0297 (DB-46): no client column grant; read through app.coaching_settings.
  tournaments_enabled boolean not null default false — Tournaments (M7). Whether this branch runs tournaments. False (the default, every branch): no publish and no registration (TOURNAMENTS_OFF), the public reads answer off; a published tournament keeps running to its end. Owner-set via app.set_tournaments_enabled.

chunks.title: table wage_payments
chunks.body:
wage_payments (0270): the owner marked a person's pay month paid at a branch, with a snapshot of the figures (salary, approved deductions, lateness penalties, net, the amount paid). One row per person and month; undone, the row stays with the reason until the month is paid again. A paid month is frozen. Read by the owner only. Never readable by the owner assistant or any LLM.
Created in migration 0270.
Columns:
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() — Payment id.
  venue_id uuid not null references venues(id) — The branch that paid it.
  staff_id uuid not null references staff(id) — The person paid.
  pay_month date not null — The pay month (the first day of that month).
  due_date date not null — The pay day in that month, as it was when paid.
  salary_iqd iqd not null — Snapshot: the salary for the month.
  deductions_iqd iqd not null — Snapshot: the approved deductions whose pay month it is.
  deduction_count int not null — Snapshot: how many approved deductions.
  penalties_iqd iqd not null — Snapshot: the lateness penalties whose pay month it is.
  penalty_days int not null — Snapshot: how many days cost a penalty.
  net_iqd iqd_signed not null — Snapshot: salary minus deductions minus penalties; may be below zero.
  paid_iqd iqd not null — The amount paid: the net, or 0 when the net is below zero (nothing carries over).

  undone_by uuid references staff(id) — The owner who undid it.

chunks.body:
tips.occupancy: الدقائق المحجوزة مقسومة على دقائق فتح المكان، محسوبة من ساعات الفتح بعد استبعاد أيام الإغلاق ومضروبة في عدد الملاعب. يُفترض أن كل الملاعب تفتح الساعات نفسها.
tips.revenue: سعر الحجز للحجوزات الفعلية. ما يخص الكافيه في الفاتورة غير محتسب.
tips.revPerOpenHour: إيراد الملاعب لكل ساعة فتح للمكان، عبر كل الملاعب.
tips.pricePerBookedHour: إيراد الملاعب لكل ساعة محجوزة فعلًا: ما تُباع به ساعة الملعب في المتوسط.
tips.cancelRate: نسبة الإلغاءات من كل ما حُجز (الفعلي والملغى وحالات عدم الحضور). تُعرض كعدد حتى تبلغ الحجوزات عشرين.
tips.noShowRate: نسبة حالات عدم الحضور من كل ما حُجز. تُعرض كعدد حتى تبلغ الحجوزات عشرين.
tips.lost: الإلغاءات وعدم الحضور معًا من كل ما حُجز (الفعلي والملغى وحالات عدم الحضور). تُعرض كعدد حتى تبلغ الحجوزات عشرين. يفتح كل منهما معاملاته.
tips.insights: يقرأ نموذج ذكاء اصطناعي أرقام هذا التبويب والأنماط المعروضة بجانبها، ويكتب استنتاجات. كل تشغيل مدفوع. ومن دون مفتاح الذكاء الاصطناعي تُكتب الاستنتاجات من قوالب جاهزة مبنية على الأرقام نفسها.
tips.attachRate: الحجوزات التي ربط بها الصندوق فاتورة واحدة على الأقل. طلبات QR من طاولة الكافيه لا تُربط، فالرقم يعكس طريقة العمل على الصندوق بقدر ما يعكس سلوك الضيوف.
tips.heatmap: كل خلية هي الدقائق المحجوزة مقسومة على دقائق فتح كل الملاعب في تلك الساعة، ويُحدَّد اليوم بيوم عمل الحجز (حجز الساعة 01:00 يُحسب مع مساء اليوم السابق). لا تُعدّ فترات الصيانة والملاعب الخارجة من الخدمة وقت فتح. يتوزع حجز مدته 90 دقيقة على الساعات التي يغطيها. الخلايا ذات الخطوط المائلة كانت مغلقة.
tips.byHour: الإشغال خلال الفترة لكل ساعة من اليوم، لكل الملاعب والأيام معًا.
tips.byWeekday: الإشغال خلال الفترة لكل يوم من أيام الأسبوع، لكل الملاعب والساعات معًا.
tips.duration: الحجوزات الفعلية حسب المدة، مع إيراد كل مدة لكل ساعة محجوزة.
tips.leadTime: الوقت بين إنشاء الحجز وبدايته، للحجوزات لمرة واحدة فقط.
tips.sourceByHour: المدة بين إنشاء الحجوزات لمرة واحدة وبدايتها، مقسّمة بحسب إنشائها في التطبيق أو في المكتب.
tips.createdHour: ساعة اليوم التي أُنشئت فيها الحجوزات لمرة واحدة، لا التي لُعبت فيها.

chunks.title: ws.analytics.courts (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/analytics.en.ts)
chunks.body:
tips.occupancy: Booked minutes over the minutes the venue was open, from the opening hours with closed dates removed, times the number of courts. Every court is assumed open the same hours.
tips.revenue: The booking price of live bookings. The cafe part of a bill is not included.
tips.revPerOpenHour: Court revenue for each hour the venue was open, across all courts.
tips.pricePerBookedHour: Court revenue for each hour actually booked: what an hour of court time sells for on average.
tips.cancelRate: Cancellations over everything that was booked (live plus cancelled plus no-show). Shown as a count until there are twenty bookings.
tips.noShowRate: No-shows over everything that was booked. Shown as a count until there are twenty bookings.
tips.lost: Cancellations plus no-shows over everything that was booked (live, cancelled and no-show). Shown as a count until there are twenty bookings. Each opens its own transactions.
tips.insights: A model reads this tab's numbers and the patterns beside it, and writes findings. Each run is billed; without an AI key the findings are templates from the same numbers.
tips.attachRate: Bookings with at least one tab the till linked to them. QR orders at a cafe table are not linked, so this is the till habit as much as the guests'.
tips.heatmap: Each cell is booked minutes over the minutes every court was open in that hour, keyed by the business weekday of the booking (a 01:00 booking counts with the evening before). Maintenance blocks and retired courts are not open time. A 90-minute booking splits across the hours it covers. Hatched cells were closed.
tips.byHour: Occupancy across the period for each hour of the day, every court and weekday together.
tips.byWeekday: Occupancy across the period for each weekday, every court and hour together.
tips.duration: Live bookings by length, with the revenue each length earns per booked hour.
tips.leadTime: Time between the booking being made and its start, for one-off bookings only.

chunks.title: ws.analytics.courts (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/analytics.ar.ts)
chunks.body:
tips.seriesShare: الحجوزات الثابتة هي تكرارات السلاسل، وكل ما سواها حجوزات لمرة واحدة.
tips.holdFunnel: الحجوزات المؤقتة من التطبيق التي تحولت إلى حجوزات، مقابل التي انتهت مهلتها أو حرّرها الضيف. لا تُحتسب الحجوزات المؤقتة من المكتب.
tips.courtTable: صف لكل ملعب خلال الفترة. ساعات الفتح المعتمدة في الحساب واحدة لكل المكان، لذا يفترض الإشغال أن كل الملاعب تفتح الساعات نفسها.
tips.losses: الإلغاءات وعدم الحضور كحصة من كل ما حُجز في تلك الشريحة: الفعلي والملغى وحالات عدم الحضور، حسب يوم الحجز. تُرسم الشريحة التي فيها أقل من عشرين حجزًا باهتة، وتظهر في الجدول كعدد لا كنسبة.
tips.notice: المدة بين الإلغاء وبداية الحجز. عدم الحضور يكون بلا إشعار مسبق.
tips.lossByWho: هل ألغى الضيف الحجز أم المكتب، بحسب الحجوزات الملغاة بعد بدء تسجيل ذلك. تبيّن الأعداد كم حجزًا ملغى كان موعده ضمن هذه الفترة، وكم إلغاءً جرى خلالها.
tips.afterLate: الإلغاءات التي جاءت قبل بداية الحجز بأقل من مهلة الإلغاء في المكان ({window}) وحُجز موعدها من جديد بحجز لاحق، مقابل التي بقيت فارغة. الإيراد المحرَّر هو سعر كل إلغاء متأخر.
tips.returning: يُعدّ الحجز عائدًا إذا كان للضيف نفسه (الحساب نفسه أو رقم الهاتف نفسه) حجز فعلي خلال الأشهر الستة التي سبقت الفترة. أعداد فقط، ولا تُذكر أسماء.
tips.frequency: عدد الحجوزات الفعلية لكل ضيف معرّف في الفترة.
tips.regulars: ضيوف لهم ثلاثة حجوزات فعلية أو أكثر في آخر تسعين يومًا. «انقطعوا» تعني عدم وجود حجز في آخر أربعة أسابيع.

chunks.title: ws.analytics.courts (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/analytics.en.ts)
chunks.body:
tips.sourceByHour: How far ahead one-off bookings were made, split by whether they were made in the app or at the desk.
tips.createdHour: The hour of the day at which one-off bookings were made, not played.
tips.seriesShare: Standing bookings are series occurrences; one-offs are everything else.
tips.holdFunnel: App holds that became bookings against holds that expired or were released by the guest. Desk holds are not counted.
tips.courtTable: One row per court over the period. The open-hours denominator is venue-wide, so occupancy assumes every court is open the same hours.
tips.losses: Cancellations and no-shows as a share of everything booked in that segment: live, cancelled and no-show, on the slot's day. A segment with fewer than twenty bookings is painted muted and printed as a count in the table, never as a rate.
tips.notice: How long before the start a cancellation was made. No-shows have no notice.
tips.lossByWho: Whether the guest or the desk cancelled, from bookings cancelled after this was recorded. The counts say how many were cancelled by the day of the slot and how many during this period.
tips.afterLate: Cancellations made with less notice than the venue's policy ({window}) whose court time was booked again by a later booking, against those that stayed empty. Freed revenue is the price of every late cancellation.
tips.returning: A booking is returning when the same guest (account, or the same phone number) had a live booking in the six months before the period. Counts only, nobody is named.
tips.frequency: How many live bookings each identified guest had in the period.
tips.regulars: Guests with three or more live bookings in the last ninety days. Gone quiet means no booking in the last four weeks.
tips.byWeek: Identified guests seen each week, split into those seen for the first time and those seen before.
tips.patterns: Mined from the bookings on this page with explicit sample floors. Nothing below its floor is shown; a wider window reveals more.

orders.floor.body: الطاولات الخضراء عليها فاتورة مفتوحة. اضغط طاولة خضراء للإضافة إلى فاتورتها، أو طاولة فارغة لفتح فاتورة عليها.

orders.items.title: أضف الأصناف

orders.notes.title: ملاحظات للمطبخ

chunks.title: ws.guide.cashier (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
start.title: Start of shift
start.day.title: Is the day open?
start.day.body: If no business day is open, the till says so and takes no orders. A manager opens the day on Day close.
start.shift.title: Start your shift
start.shift.body: At the top of the till, check the amount it asks about. If it is in the drawer, press {confirm}; if not, press {different} and type what you counted.
start.others.title: Someone else’s shift is still open
start.others.body: Count their drawer and close their shift with a manager’s PIN, then start yours.
start.sound.title: Sound
start.sound.body: If the {turnOnSound} strip shows, press it so waiter calls and scanned orders chime. Starting your shift turns sound on by itself.
orders.title: Taking an order
orders.floor.title: The floor plan
orders.floor.body: Green tables have an open tab. Tap a green table to add to its tab, or a free table to open a tab there.
orders.courts.title: Courts
orders.courts.body: Switch to {courts} to open a tab on a court booking.
orders.newTab.title: New tab
orders.newTab.body: Press {newTab} to open a tab for a table, a name or a booking.
orders.items.title: Add items
orders.items.body: Pick a category or search the menu. An item with one size and no extras goes straight into the basket; anything else opens a sheet to choose from.
orders.notes.title: Notes for the kitchen
orders.notes.body: The note button on a basket line offers ready-made notes, or type one the way the kitchen should read it.
orders.send.title: Send to the kitchen
orders.send.body: Press {send}. Lines you have not sent are lost if you switch to another tab, so the till asks first.
orders.calls.title: Waiter calls
orders.calls.body: Press {ack} when you go to the table, then {done} once it is handled.
orders.slips.title: Scanned orders
orders.slips.body: Check the order against the photo, then press {send} or {setAside}.
pay.title: Payment
pay.cash.title: Cash

pay.split.body: فعّل «{partial}» لاستلام جزء من الفاتورة، أو اضغط «{split}» لتقسيمها بالتساوي أو حسب الأصناف.
pay.promo.title: العروض
pay.promo.body: اضغط «{applyPromo}». تقبل الفاتورة عرضًا واحدًا.
pay.charge.title: التحميل على حجز
pay.charge.body: ينقل «{chargeBooking}» فاتورة المقهى إلى حجز ملعب، فيدفع الضيف الملعب والمقهى دفعة واحدة.
pay.bill.title: الحساب
pay.bill.body: اضغط «{bill}» لعرض الحساب على الشاشة، واطبعه من هناك.
fix.title: التصحيحات
fix.discount.title: الخصم
fix.discount.body: اضغط «{discount}»، ثم يُدخل المدير رقمه السري وتكتب أنت السبب.
fix.price.title: تغيير السعر
fix.price.body: اضغط السطر، ثم «{override}»، ثم يُدخل المدير رقمه السري وتكتب أنت السبب.
fix.void.title: إلغاء سطر مُرسَل
fix.void.body: اضغط «{void}» على السطر. يُسجَّل الإلغاء هدرًا ولا يُحذف السطر أبدًا. وإن كانت على الفاتورة دفعات، يستردها المدير أولًا.
fix.refund.title: الاسترداد
fix.refund.body: لا يسترد الدفعة إلا مدير مسجّل الدخول على الصندوق.
fix.merge.title: دمج الفواتير
fix.merge.body: في «{openTabs}» اضغط «{merge}» واختر الفاتورة التي تبقى. لا يمكن التراجع عن الدمج.
fix.remove.title: حذف فاتورة فارغة
fix.remove.body: يمكن حذف الفاتورة التي لا شيء عليها من «{openTabs}»، مع ذكر السبب.
fix.drawer.title: فتح الدرج يدويًا
fix.drawer.body: في «{cashDrawer}» اضغط «{openDrawer}» واكتب السبب.
fix.offline.title: العمل دون اتصال
fix.offline.body: تُحفظ الطلبات والدفعات والإلغاءات والاستردادات المسجّلة دون اتصال على الصندوق، وتُرسل عند عودة الاتصال. أما دمج الفواتير وفتح الدرج والورديات فتتطلب الاتصال.
more.title: المهام والاستراحة
more.tasks.title: مهامي
more.tasks.body: خطواتك في الأصناف الجديدة والبطولات وتغييرات الأسعار موجودة في «مهامي».
more.incident.title: بلِّغ عن حادث
more.incident.body: بلِّغ عن حادث أو إصابة أو شجار أو ضرر، مع الصور. يراجع المدير كل بلاغ.
more.break.title: خذ استراحة
more.break.body: اضغط «{goOnBreak}» وأدخل رقمك السري. يستطيع زميلك تغطية الصندوق برقمه السري، ورقمك السري يُنهي الاستراحة.

chunks.title: ws.guide.cashier (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
pay.cash.body: Press {cash}, type the amount handed over and give the change shown.
pay.card.title: Card
pay.card.body: Press {card}, take the payment on the card machine, then record the amount it approved.
pay.split.title: Part payments and splits
pay.split.body: Turn on {partial} to take part of the bill, or press {split} to share it evenly or by item.
pay.promo.title: Promotions
pay.promo.body: Press {applyPromo}. A tab takes one promotion.
pay.charge.title: Charge to a booking
pay.charge.body: {chargeBooking} moves the café tab onto a court booking, so the guest pays for the court and the café in one go.
pay.bill.title: The bill
pay.bill.body: Press {bill} to show the bill on screen, and print it from there.
fix.title: Corrections
fix.discount.title: Discount
fix.discount.body: Press {discount}, then a manager enters their PIN and you give a reason.
fix.price.title: Change a price
fix.price.body: Tap the line, press {override}, then a manager enters their PIN and you give a reason.
fix.void.title: Void a sent line
fix.void.body: Press {void} on the line. It is recorded as waste, never deleted. If the tab already has payments, a manager refunds them first.
fix.refund.title: Refunds
fix.refund.body: Only a manager signed in on the till can refund a payment.
fix.merge.title: Merge tabs
fix.merge.body: On {openTabs}, press {merge} and choose the tab that stays. A merge cannot be undone.
fix.remove.title: Remove an empty tab
fix.remove.body: A tab with nothing on it can be removed from {openTabs}, with a reason.
fix.drawer.title: Open the drawer by hand
fix.drawer.body: On {cashDrawer}, press {openDrawer} and give the reason.
fix.offline.title: Working offline
fix.offline.body: Orders, payments, voids and refunds made offline are saved on the till and sent when the connection returns. Merging tabs, opening the drawer and shifts need the connection.
more.title: Tasks and breaks

chunks.title: ws.guide.courtDesk (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.ar.ts)
chunks.body:
start.title: بداية الوردية
start.shift.title: ابدأ ورديتك
start.shift.body: اضغط «{startShift}» في شاشة اليوم أو في الشريط الجانبي. في أول وردية من اليوم تَعُدّ النقد في صندوق المكتب، وفي الورديات التالية تؤكد ما سُلّم إليك أو تكتب ما عددته. وإن لم يُفتح يوم العمل بعد، يفتحه المدير من شاشة إغلاق اليوم.
start.board.title: اقرأ لوحة اليوم
start.board.body: في الأعلى «{arrivals}»، ثم «{courtsNow}»، ثم «{allBookings}». وحين تكون المباريات المفتوحة مفعّلة، تظهر المباريات التي تبحث عن لاعبين قبل القائمة الكاملة.
bookings.title: الحجوزات
bookings.newBooking.title: احجز ملعبًا
bookings.newBooking.body: اضغط «{newBooking}». ابحث عن الضيف بالاسم أو رقم الهاتف، أو اكتب اسمًا فقط. اختر الملعب ووقت البدء والمدة: يظهر السعر قبل الحفظ، وتُعلَّم الأوقات المحجوزة.
bookings.walkIn.title: الحضور دون حجز
bookings.walkIn.body: في «{courtsNow}» يُحجز الملعب الفارغ في الحال، ويفتح الملعب المشغول حجزه.
bookings.calendar.title: التقويم
bookings.calendar.body: انقر على خانة فارغة لحجزها. تنقلك مفاتيح الأسهم إلى اليوم التالي أو السابق (أو الشهر في عرض الشهر)، ويعرض المفتاح D يومًا واحدًا والمفتاح M الشهر كاملًا.
bookings.change.title: النقل أو التقصير أو التمديد
bookings.change.body: اسحب الحجز من مقبضه في التقويم، أو افتحه واضغط «{move}» أو «{shorten}» أو «{extend}». يطلب كل تغيير سببًا.
bookings.cancel.title: إلغاء حجز
bookings.cancel.body: افتح الحجز واضغط «{cancel}» واختر سببًا. أما الحجز المكتمل أو الملغى أو المسجّل عدم حضوره فلا يمكن تغييره.
bookings.series.title: الحجوزات الأسبوعية الثابتة
bookings.series.body: اضغط «{newSeries}» في التقويم. يُفحص كل تاريخ قبل حجز أي شيء: تخطَّ التواريخ المتعارضة أو انقلها، ثم احجز السلسلة.
bookings.block.title: إغلاق ملعب
bookings.block.body: للصيانة، اضغط «{blockCourt}» في التقويم. لا يتجاوز الإغلاق يومًا واحدًا، ويُرفض إن تداخل مع حجز.
bookings.offline.title: الحجز دون اتصال
bookings.offline.body: يُحفظ الحجز المسجّل دون اتصال على هذه المحطة فقط. لا تَعِد الضيف بالموعد حتى تتم مزامنته.
arrivals.title: الوصول
arrivals.arrived.title: سجّل الوصول

chunks.title: ws.guide.courtDesk (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
start.title: Start of shift
start.shift.title: Start your shift
start.shift.body: Press {startShift} on Today or on the rail. The day’s first shift counts the cash in the desk’s box; a later one confirms what was handed over, or you type what you counted. If the day is not open yet, a manager opens it on Day close.
start.board.title: Read the Today board
start.board.body: {arrivals} is at the top, then {courtsNow}, then {allBookings}. When open matches are on, the matches still looking for players come before the full list.
bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.newBooking.title: Book a court
bookings.newBooking.body: Press {newBooking}. Find the guest by name or phone, or just type a name. Pick the court, the start and the length: the price shows before you save, and times already taken are marked.
bookings.walkIn.title: Walk-ins
bookings.walkIn.body: Under {courtsNow}, a free court books it on the spot and a busy one opens its booking.
bookings.calendar.title: The calendar
bookings.calendar.body: Click a free slot to book it. The arrow keys move to the next or previous day (a month in the month view); D shows one day and M the whole month.
bookings.change.title: Move, shorten or extend
bookings.change.body: Drag a booking by its grip on the calendar, or open it and press {move}, {shorten} or {extend}. Each change asks for a reason.
bookings.cancel.title: Cancel a booking
bookings.cancel.body: Open the booking, press {cancel} and choose a reason. A booking that is completed, cancelled or a no-show can no longer change.
bookings.series.title: Weekly regulars
bookings.series.body: Press {newSeries} on the calendar. Every date is checked before anything is booked: skip or move the dates that clash, then book the series.
bookings.block.title: Block a court
bookings.block.body: For maintenance, press {blockCourt} on the calendar. A block stays within one day, and it is refused if a booking overlaps it.
bookings.offline.title: Booking without a connection

chunks.title: ws.guide.courtDesk (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.ar.ts)
chunks.body:
arrivals.arrived.body: اضغط «{markArrived}» عند دخول اللاعبين: ضغطة واحدة دون سبب. ويبقى الحجز الذي بدأ دون تسجيل وصول قرب الأعلى، تحت «{late}».
arrivals.noShow.title: عدم الحضور والاكتمال
arrivals.noShow.body: بعد أن يبدأ الموعد، افتح الحجز واضغط «{noShow}» أو «{completed}».
money.title: استلام الدفع
money.fee.title: استلم رسوم الملعب
money.fee.body: في الحجز، اضغط «{cash}» أو «{card}». في الدفع النقدي اكتب المبلغ المُسلَّم، فيظهر الباقي الذي تعيده.
money.cafe.title: أضف فاتورة المقهى
money.cafe.body: ينقل «{addCafeBill}» فاتورة طاولة مفتوحة إلى الحجز، فيدفع الضيوف الملعب والمقهى معًا.
money.unpaid.title: لُعبت ولم تُدفع
money.unpaid.body: تظهر المباريات التي انتهت ورسوم ملعبها لم تُسدَّد تحت «{toSettle}» في شاشة اليوم. افتح كلًّا منها واستلم الدفع.
money.closeBill.title: لا مبلغ مستحق
money.closeBill.body: إن لم يكن على فاتورة الحجز المفتوحة أي مبلغ، اضغط «{closeBill}» ليتمكن اليوم من الإغلاق.
money.deposit.title: عربون التطبيق
money.deposit.body: يظهر العربون المدفوع في التطبيق بعبارة «{paidOnline}». استلم الباقي فقط.
money.overpaid.title: دفعة زائدة
money.overpaid.body: إن دُفع للحجز أكثر مما عليه، يردّ المدير الفرق من الصندوق، ثم يمكن إغلاق الفاتورة.
customers.title: الزبائن
customers.find.title: ابحث عن زبون
customers.find.body: ابحث برقم الهاتف أو الاسم أو البريد الإلكتروني. يعرض السجل حجوزاته وعلاماته وملاحظات الموظفين.
customers.create.title: أنشئ زبونًا
customers.create.body: الزبون الجديد حساب ضيف حقيقي، يستطيع صاحبه أن يطالب به لاحقًا في التطبيق.
customers.flags.title: العلامات وملاحظات الموظفين
customers.flags.body: تظهر العلامات على حجوزات الضيف وفواتيره. أما ملاحظات الموظفين فللموظفين وحدهم، ولا يراها الضيف أبدًا.
matches.title: المباريات المفتوحة
matches.start.title: ابدأ مباراة مفتوحة
matches.start.body: اختر «{openMatch}» في الحجز الجديد، أو اضغط «{startMatch}» في شاشة اليوم. ثم اضغط «{copyLink}» وشارك الدعوة.
matches.players.title: اللاعبون
matches.players.body: في «{players}» أضف اللاعبين، وسجّل وصول كل منهم أو عدم حضوره، واستلم حصة كل لاعب.

chunks.title: ws.guide.courtDesk (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
bookings.offline.body: A booking made offline is saved on this station only. Do not promise the slot until it has synced.
arrivals.title: Arrivals
arrivals.arrived.title: Mark arrived
arrivals.arrived.body: Press {markArrived} when the players come in: one press, no reason. A booking that has started with nobody marked stays near the top, under {late}.
arrivals.noShow.title: No-show and completed
arrivals.noShow.body: Once the slot has started, open the booking and press {noShow} or {completed}.
money.title: Taking payment
money.fee.title: Take the court fee
money.fee.body: On the booking, press {cash} or {card}. For cash, type the amount handed over and the change to give shows.
money.cafe.title: Add their café bill
money.cafe.body: {addCafeBill} moves a table’s open bill onto the booking, so they pay for the court and the café together.
money.unpaid.title: Played, not paid
money.unpaid.body: Games that ended with the court fee still open are listed under {toSettle} on Today. Open each one and take the payment.
money.closeBill.title: Nothing owed
money.closeBill.body: When nothing is owed on a booking’s open bill, press {closeBill} so the day can close.
money.deposit.title: App deposits
money.deposit.body: A deposit paid in the app shows as {paidOnline}. Take only the rest.
money.overpaid.title: Overpaid
money.overpaid.body: If a booking was paid more than it owes, a manager refunds the difference at the till, and then the bill can close.
customers.title: Customers
customers.find.title: Find a customer
customers.find.body: Search by phone, name or email. The record shows their bookings, their flags and the staff notes.
customers.create.title: Create a customer
customers.create.body: A new customer is a real guest account, which the customer can claim later in the app.
customers.flags.title: Flags and staff notes
customers.flags.body: Flags show on the guest’s bookings and tabs. Staff notes are for staff only: the guest never sees them.
matches.title: Open matches

chunks.title: ws.guide.courtDesk (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.ar.ts)
chunks.body:
matches.writeOff.title: شطب حصة
matches.writeOff.body: يُسقط «{writeOff}» حصة اللاعب دون دفع، ويأذن به المدير برقمه السري.
matches.callOff.title: الإلغاء لنقص اللاعبين أو الإلغاء
matches.callOff.body: ألغِ المباراة لنقص اللاعبين حين لا يكتمل عددهم: لا يدفع أحد، ويجب تسجيل حالة كل لاعب أولًا. أما المباراة التي لا تزال تستقبل لاعبين فتُلغى إلغاءً عاديًا.
more.title: المهام والاستراحة
more.tasks.title: مهامي
more.tasks.body: خطواتك في البطولات والأصناف الجديدة وتغييرات الأسعار موجودة في «مهامي».
more.incident.title: بلِّغ عن حادث
more.incident.body: بلِّغ عن حادث أو إصابة أو شجار أو ضرر، مع الصور. يراجع المدير كل بلاغ.
more.break.title: خذ استراحة
more.break.body: اضغط «{goOnBreak}» وأدخل رقمك السري. يستطيع زميلك تغطية المحطة برقمه السري، ورقمك السري يُنهي الاستراحة.
end.title: نهاية الوردية
end.shift.title: أنهِ ورديتك
end.shift.body: اضغط «{endShift}» وعُدّ ما في الصندوق دون أن ترى المبلغ المتوقع. لا يظهر الفرق إلا بعد أن توقّع برقمك السري.
end.signOut.title: تسجيل الخروج
end.signOut.body: إن كانت ورديتك لا تزال مفتوحة، يعرض عليك تسجيل الخروج إنهاءها أولًا. وإن خرجت دون إنهائها تبقى مفتوحة حتى يغلقها المدير.

chunks.title: ws.guide.courtDesk (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
matches.start.title: Start an open match
matches.start.body: Choose {openMatch} in the new booking, or press {startMatch} on Today. Then press {copyLink} and share the invite.
matches.players.title: Players
matches.players.body: Under {players}, add players, mark each one arrived or no-show, and take each share.
matches.writeOff.title: Write off a share
matches.writeOff.body: {writeOff} clears a player’s share without payment. A manager’s PIN authorises it.
matches.callOff.title: Call off or cancel
matches.callOff.body: Call off a match that is short of players: nobody pays, and every player must be marked first. Cancel a match while it is still filling.
more.title: Tasks and breaks
more.tasks.title: My tasks
more.tasks.body: Your steps in tournaments, new items and price changes are on My tasks.
more.incident.title: Report an incident
more.incident.body: Report an incident, an injury, a fight or damage, with photos. A manager reviews every report.
more.break.title: Take a break
more.break.body: Press {goOnBreak} and enter your PIN. A colleague can cover the station with their own PIN, and your PIN ends the break.
end.title: End of shift
end.shift.title: End your shift
end.shift.body: Press {endShift} and count the box without seeing the amount expected. The difference shows only after you sign with your PIN.
end.signOut.title: Sign out
end.signOut.body: If your shift is still open, signing out offers to end it first. Signing out anyway leaves it open until a manager closes it.

chunks.title: ws.guide.prep (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.ar.ts)
chunks.body:
start.title: بداية الوردية
start.sound.title: شغّل الصوت
start.sound.body: إن ظهر الشريط الكهرماني «{turnOnSound}» في الأعلى فاضغطه. فبدون الصوت لا تُنبّه الطلبات الجديدة ولا التذاكر المتأخرة.
start.connection.title: تحقق من الاتصال
start.connection.body: يجب أن تقرأ الشارة في أعلى الشاشة «{live}». وأي حالة أخرى تعني أن التذاكر الجديدة قد تصل متأخرة.
tickets.title: قراءة التذكرة
tickets.source.title: من أين تأتي التذاكر
tickets.source.body: تصل إلى هنا الطلبات المرسلة من الصندوق ومن الضيوف عبر الموقع، الأقدم أولًا. وتبيّن كل بطاقة مصدرها: «{till}» أو «{web}».
tickets.card.title: ما تعرضه البطاقة
tickets.card.body: الطاولة أو الملعب، وعمر التذكرة مقارنةً بالوقت المستهدف، ومن أرسلها، وكل صنف بحجمه وإضافاته وملاحظاته.
tickets.band.title: شريط اللون
tickets.band.body: يتدرج الشريط أعلى البطاقة من «{onTime}» إلى «{gettingLate}» إلى «{late}». ابدأ بالأكثر إلحاحًا.
work.title: العمل على التذكرة
work.start.title: البدء
work.start.body: اضغط «{start}» على التذكرة حين تبدأ تحضيرها.
work.tick.title: تأشير الأصناف
work.tick.body: اضغط صنفًا لتأشيره جاهزًا، أو استخدم المفتاح للصنف الواقع تحت المؤشر. وترى شاشات المطبخ الأخرى هذه التأشيرات.
work.ready.title: جاهزة
work.ready.body: اضغط «{ready}» حين تجهز التذكرة كاملة. ويمكن نقل تذكرة لم يبدأها أحد إلى «{ready}» مباشرة.
work.complete.title: الإكمال
work.complete.body: اضغط «{complete}» بعد خروج الطلب. تبهت التذكرة وتغادر اللوحة بعد {minutes} دقيقة.
alerts.title: التذاكر المتأخرة
alerts.stale.title: لم تبدأ في وقتها
alerts.stale.body: التذكرة التي لا تبدأ خلال {seconds} ثانية تُعلَّم بعبارة «{stale}»، ويحيط بها إطار أحمر، وتُضاف إلى العدد في الشريط الأحمر. وتُنبّه كل {repeat} ثانية حتى يبدأها أحد.
alerts.voided.title: الأسطر الملغاة
alerts.voided.body: حين يلغي الصندوق سطرًا، يختفي من تذكرته.
keys.title: المفاتيح
keys.tickets.title: التنقل بين التذاكر
keys.tickets.body: اختر تذكرة بموضعها على اللوحة، أو انتقل إلى التالية أو السابقة. وفي العربية تتبع الأسهم اتجاه القراءة.
keys.items.title: الأصناف وإلغاء التحديد وهذا الدليل

chunks.title: ws.guide.prep (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
start.title: Start of shift
start.sound.title: Turn on sound
start.sound.body: If the amber {turnOnSound} strip shows across the top, press it. Without sound, new orders and late tickets do not chime.
start.connection.title: Check the connection
start.connection.body: The pill in the header should read {live}. Anything else means new tickets may reach this screen late.
tickets.title: Reading a ticket
tickets.source.title: Where tickets come from
tickets.source.body: Orders sent from the till and by guests on the website arrive here, oldest first. Each card says which: {till} or {web}.
tickets.card.title: What a card shows
tickets.card.body: The table or court, the ticket’s age against its target, who sent it, and each item with its size, its extras and the notes.
tickets.band.title: The colour band
tickets.band.body: The band across the top of a card goes from {onTime} to {gettingLate} to {late}. Work the most urgent first.
work.title: Working a ticket
work.start.title: Start
work.start.body: Press {start} on a ticket when you begin it.
work.tick.title: Tick items
work.tick.body: Tap an item to tick it ready, or use the key for the item under the cursor. The other kitchen screens see the ticks.
work.ready.title: Ready
work.ready.body: Press {ready} when the whole ticket is done. A ticket nobody has started can go straight to {ready}.
work.complete.title: Complete
work.complete.body: Press {complete} once it has gone out. It fades and leaves the board after {minutes} minutes.
alerts.title: Late tickets
alerts.stale.title: Not started in time
alerts.stale.body: A ticket not started within {seconds} seconds is marked {stale}, gets a red ring and joins the count in the red banner. It chimes every {repeat} seconds until someone starts it.
alerts.voided.title: Voided lines

start.title: بداية الوردية
start.shift.title: ابدأ ورديتك
start.shift.body: تطلب منك أول دفعة أن تبدأ ورديتك على هذا الحاسوب: أكّد المبلغ الذي في الدرج، أو اكتب ما عددته. وإن لم يُفتح يوم العمل بعد، فاطلب من المدير فتحه.

sell.basket.title: البيع الحالي
sell.basket.body: غيّر الكمية بزرَّي الزيادة والنقصان، أو احذف سطرًا، أو اضغط «{clear}» لتبدأ من جديد.

sell.unfinished.title: المبيعات غير المكتملة

sell.offline.title: البيع دون اتصال

stock.receive.title: استلام البضائع

stock.counts.title: جرد المخزون
stock.counts.body: ابدأ الجرد وأدخل ما تراه، إذ تبقى الكمية المسجّلة مخفية. ثم أنهِ الجرد أو تجاهله.
stock.waste.title: الهدر

products.products.body: أضف الأقسام، ثم المنتجات برمزها وباركودها وسعرها ومورّدها، ثم أحجامها.
products.prices.title: الأسعار وطرح المنتجات للبيع
products.prices.body: غيّر السعر من نموذج تعديل المنتج. ويُطرح المنتج الجديد للبيع فور حفظه.
products.suppliers.title: المورّدون
products.suppliers.body: احفظ مورّدي المتجر هنا، ليحدد كل منتج المورّد الذي يأتي منه.

chunks.title: ws.guide.shop (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
start.title: Start of shift
start.shift.title: Start your shift
start.shift.body: The first payment asks you to start your shift at this PC: confirm the amount in the drawer, or type what you counted. If the day is not open yet, ask a manager to open it.
sell.title: Selling
sell.find.title: Find a product
sell.find.body: Scan the barcode, search by name, SKU or barcode, or tap a product. A product out of stock is greyed out.
sell.basket.title: The sale
sell.basket.body: Change a quantity with the plus and minus buttons, remove a line, or press {clear} to start again.
sell.pay.title: Cash or card
sell.pay.body: Press {cash} or {card}. Every sale is paid on the spot, and the receipt prints by itself.
sell.unfinished.title: Unfinished sales
sell.unfinished.body: A sale rung up but not paid waits under {unfinished}. Press {resume} to take the payment.
sell.offline.title: Selling offline
sell.offline.body: A sale made without a connection is saved on this PC and goes through when the connection is back.
stock.title: Stock
stock.onHand.title: On hand and history
stock.onHand.body: {shopStock} lists what the shop holds; a row’s history shows every movement. Use the rail for goods in, counts and waste.
stock.receive.title: Goods in
stock.receive.body: Enter what arrived. The stock goes up as soon as you record it.
stock.counts.title: Stock counts
stock.counts.body: Start a count and enter what you see: the recorded amount stays hidden. Then finish the count, or discard it.
stock.waste.title: Waste
stock.waste.body: Record the item, the quantity, what happened and a note. All four are needed.
products.title: Products
products.products.title: Sections, products and sizes
products.products.body: Add sections, then products with their SKU, barcode, price and supplier, and then their sizes.
products.prices.title: Prices and going on sale
products.prices.body: Change a price in the product’s edit form. A new product goes on sale as soon as you save it.

end.drawer.body: في «{cashDrawer}» اضغط «{openDrawer}» واكتب السبب.
end.break.title: خذ استراحة
end.break.body: اضغط «{goOnBreak}» وأدخل رقمك السري. ورقمك السري يُنهي الاستراحة.
end.unpaid.title: لا مبيعات غير مدفوعة
end.unpaid.body: لا يُغلق اليوم ما دام في المتجر بيع غير مدفوع. استلم كل دفعة في «{unfinished}» قبل أن تغادر.
end.shift.title: أنهِ ورديتك
end.shift.body: اضغط «{endShift}» وعُدّ ما في الدرج دون أن ترى المبلغ المتوقع. وقّع برقمك السري، وبعدها يظهر الفرق.
end.signOut.title: تسجيل الخروج
end.signOut.body: إن كانت ورديتك لا تزال مفتوحة، يعرض عليك تسجيل الخروج إنهاءها أولًا. وإن خرجت دون إنهائها تبقى مفتوحة حتى يغلقها المدير.

chunks.title: ws.guide.shop (packages/i18n/src/catalogs/ws/guide.en.ts)
chunks.body:
products.suppliers.title: Suppliers
products.suppliers.body: Keep the shop’s suppliers here, so each product can name the one it comes from.
end.title: End of shift
end.drawer.title: Open the drawer by hand
end.drawer.body: On {cashDrawer}, press {openDrawer} and give the reason.
end.break.title: Take a break
end.break.body: Press {goOnBreak} and enter your PIN. Your PIN ends the break.
end.unpaid.title: No unpaid sales
end.unpaid.body: The day cannot close while a shop sale is unpaid. Take every payment under {unfinished} before you leave.
end.shift.title: End your shift
end.shift.body: Press {endShift} and count the drawer without seeing the amount expected. Sign with your PIN; the difference shows after that.
end.signOut.title: Sign out
end.signOut.body: If your shift is still open, signing out offers to end it first. Signing out anyway leaves it open until a manager closes it.
